title: Store Manager- Inventory and Logistics
description:
**Job Title**
– Store Manager – Inventory & Logistics

**Location**
– Leanwatts HQ, Hyderabad, India

**About us**
: At Leanwatts, we develop innovative power electronic solutions for electric mobility and energy applications through continuous research, engineering, and manufacturing. Our “Designed and Made in India” approach drives us to build reliable, high-performance products for the future of transportation and energy.

**What is this role about?**

We are looking for a hands-on Store Manager to take ownership of material receipts, inventory accuracy, and logistics at Leanwatts. You will inward materials in our inventory/ERP system and ensure the right materials reach Production and Research & Development (R&D) teams on time. You will manage the flow of electronic components, PCBs, mechanical parts, assemblies, and consumables—from receipt and storage to issue, return, and dispatch. The role requires accurate system entries, organised stores, and close coordination with Purchase, Quality, Production, R&D, and Finance.

**What you will do at Leanwatts:**

● Material Receipt & Verification: Receive materials and check item codes, part numbers, quantities, and condition against purchase orders and supplier documents. Record and resolve shortages, excess receipts, damage, and mismatches with Purchase and suppliers.

● System Inwarding & GRNs: Create accurate, timely inward entries and Goods Receipt Notes (GRNs) in the company’s inventory/ERP system. Capture batch/serial details where applicable, attach supporting documents, and maintain an auditable record of each receipt.

● Quality Coordination: Route incoming materials for required inspection and keep accepted, pending-inspection, and rejected stock clearly separated. Release materials only after the required approval and coordinate supplier returns for rejected items.

● Storage & Inventory Control: Label materials and assign bin locations for easy identification and retrieval. Maintain accurate stock records, follow FIFO/FEFO where applicable, and flag low stock, ageing stock, and excess inventory for action.

● Material Issue to Production: Pick and issue materials against approved requisitions, bills of materials (BOMs), or production orders. Record quantities and job/order references in the system, obtain receipt acknowledgement, and reconcile unused material returns.

● Material Issue to R&D: Support prototype builds and testing by issuing components, samples, and consumables against approved requests. Track issues by project or cost centre, record consumption and returns, and maintain traceability for small-quantity and urgent requirements.

● Inbound & Outbound Logistics: Coordinate supplier pickups, courier and transporter bookings, packing, dispatch, and delivery tracking. Arrange required invoices, delivery challans, and applicable transport documents with the responsible teams, and follow up on delays and proof of delivery.

● Stock Verification & Reconciliation: Carry out cycle counts and periodic physical stock checks, reconcile physical stock with system balances, and investigate discrepancies. Process adjustments, write-offs, and scrap movements only with the required approvals.

● Planning, Reporting & Coordination: Share stock availability, shortages, pending receipts, and dispatch status with relevant teams. Track inventory accuracy, receipt-entry turnaround, material-issue timeliness, and logistics performance; organise daily stores work and maintain housekeeping.

**Must have requirements**

**1. Education & Relevant Experience:**

● Education: Diploma or bachelor’s degree in commerce, engineering, logistics, supply chain, or a related field; candidates with strong relevant stores experience may also be considered.

● Experience: Practical experience in manufacturing stores, inventory control, material inwarding, and logistics coordination, with the ability to manage daily operations independently.

● Hands-On Ownership: Experience personally creating receipt/GRN entries, issuing materials to internal teams, reconciling stock, and maintaining supporting records—not solely supervising these activities.

**2. Inventory Systems & Documentation:**

● System Skills: Working proficiency in an ERP or inventory management system, including receipts, material issues, returns, transfers, stock reports, and traceability records. Ability to learn Leanwatts’ system quickly.

● Documentation & Excel: Ability to verify purchase orders, invoices, and delivery challans; maintain clear transaction records; and use Excel or Google Sheets for stock reconciliation and reporting.

**3. Production & R&D Material Support:**

You should be comfortable supporting both planned production requirements and changing R&D needs while ensuring every material movement is authorised and recorded.

● Material Identification: Ability to distinguish item codes, manufacturer part numbers, specifications, units of measure, and approved revisions. Do not substitute components without approval from the responsible team.

● Planning & Communication: Ability to read material requisitions and BOMs, prepare material kits, communicate shortages early, and coordinate priorities with Production, R&D, Purchase, and Quality.

**4. Logistics, Handling & Store Discipline:**

● Logistics Coordination: Experience arranging pickups and dispatches, checking packing and shipping documents, tracking deliveries, and resolving transporter or courier issues.

● Safe Material Handling: Understanding of appropriate storage and packing practices, including electrostatic discharge (ESD) precautions for sensitive electronic components and handling requirements for fragile or high-value items.

● Accuracy & Accountability: Strong attention to detail, orderly bin management, safe housekeeping, and disciplined adherence to approvals. Ability to investigate discrepancies and follow issues through to closure.

**5. Preferred Advantages**

● Industry Exposure: Experience in electronics, electrical equipment, power electronics, EV products, or engineering manufacturing; familiarity with batch/serial tracking, barcode systems, and production kitting. ● Operational Improvements: Experience supporting inventory audits, reducing stock discrepancies, improving store layout, monitoring reorder levels, or improving dispatch turnaround and freight coordination.

within defined timelines, quality standards, productivity targets and material consumption norms.

The position will have
**end-to-end responsibility for production execution**
, starting from production planning and material readiness through fabrication, assembly, quality clearance and production completion.

The candidate should be a strong
**shop-floor leader**
capable of managing manpower, machines, production priorities and operational challenges independently.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Production Leadership & Output Ownership**

* Lead the day-to-day production activities of the façade factory.

  **daily, weekly and monthly production output**
  .

* Ensure continuous production flow and eliminate avoidable bottlenecks.
* Drive the production team towards
  **output, productivity and delivery targets**
  .
* Escalate major constraints to the Production Manager/DGM with clear recovery plans.

**B. Production Planning & Scheduling**

* Prepare daily and weekly production schedules in coordination with Planning.
* Prioritize production based on project/site requirements.
* Ensure proper sequencing of cutting, CNC machining, fabrication, assembly and finishing activities.
* Plan machine loading and manpower deployment based on production requirements.
* Ensure adequate production capacity is available for upcoming project requirements.
* Coordinate with Planning and Project teams to maintain delivery commitments.

**C. Manpower Leadership**

* Lead Supervisors, Operators, Technicians and Helpers working under Production.
* Allocate manpower based on workload, skill level and machine requirements.
* Monitor individual/team productivity.
* Ensure optimum utilization of available manpower.
* Identify manpower shortages and arrange/recommend additional resources.
* Conduct daily production meetings/toolbox discussions with the production team.
* Develop multi-skilled operators to improve production flexibility.
* Maintain discipline and accountability within the production team.

**D. Machine & Capacity Utilization**

* Ensure optimum utilization of CNC machines and other fabrication equipment.
* Plan machine loading according to production requirements.
* Monitor machine utilization and production cycle times.
* Coordinate with Maintenance for preventive maintenance and breakdown recovery.
* Minimize machine idle time and production downtime.
* Identify capacity constraints and recommend process/machine improvements.
* Ensure operators follow approved machine operating procedures.

**E. Aluminium Façade & Fabrication Production**

Lead and monitor production activities related to:

* Unitized façade panels
* Semi-unitized façade
* Stick curtain wall
* Aluminium doors and windows
* Curtain wall components
* Aluminium/ACP panels
* Louvers and fins
* Canopies and architectural aluminium products
* Brackets and associated façade components

Ensure all fabrication is carried out as per
**approved shop drawings, BOM, production drawings, specifications and approved samples/mock-ups**
.

**F. Productivity & Process Improvement**

* Establish and monitor production productivity norms.
* Improve machine and manpower productivity.
* Reduce production cycle time.
* Identify repetitive process losses and implement corrective actions.
* Reduce material wastage, rejection and rework.
* Improve shop-floor layout, material movement and workflow.
* Implement Lean/5S principles wherever applicable.
* Develop standard operating methods for repetitive fabrication activities.
* Continuously improve production efficiency and capacity.

**G. Quality Control**

  in manufacturing/production.

  .
* Proven experience in
  **leading a production team and achieving production targets**
  .

* Aluminium profile fabrication
* Unitized façade production
* Curtain wall fabrication
* Doors & Windows fabrication
* CNC machining
* Double-head cutting
* End milling
* Corner crimping

* Production planning
* Capacity planning

As a Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will lead vulnerability management programs and teams across a portfolio of enterprise clients, owning service quality, client relationships, and commercial outcomes. * Lead executive client relationships, provide strategic guidance on vulnerability risk management and program maturity, and translate complex exposure data into board-level reporting and investment priorities.
* Define and execute the strategy for integrating Anthropic Claude and agentic artificial intelligence capabilities into vulnerability management services, including automation, orchestration, and operating model improvements.

* Manage and develop team members, support offering development and sales collaboration, and oversee engagement financial performance including budgeting, forecasting, utilization, and profitability.

**The team**
Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes managing the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security, business transformation, and ensuring continuous compliance. Services include Cyber-as-a-Service, Managed Application Security, and Managed Extended Detect & Respond (MXDR).

* Experience productizing artificial intelligence capabilities into repeatable service offerings or internal tools, including application programming interface architecture, cost optimization, and scalability patterns for Claude-based agents
* Experience with artificial intelligence or machine learning applied to cybersecurity, including vulnerability prediction models or artificial intelligence-assisted threat intelligence correlation
* CISSP, CISM, CRISC, Tenable Certified Security Professional, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Specialty, or equivalent certification
* Experience with attack surface management platforms and integrating external exposure data into vulnerability management prioritization workflows

* Provide technical leadership and direction to the LN Technical team.

* Review proposed technical solutions and ensure they meet customer, quality, and delivery expectations.
* Work with functional, consulting, delivery, and third-party teams to resolve complex customer requirements.
* Promote the adoption of Infor technical standards, best practices, tools, and delivery processes.
* Ensure technical documentation and knowledge-management repositories are maintained and regularly updated.

**Operational and Delivery Management**

* Work with senior management on the team’s vision, operating model, capability development, and delivery strategy.

**People and Resource Management**

* Lead, support, motivate, and empower members of the LN Technical team.
* Provide coaching and mentoring to help employees achieve individual and team objectives.
* Create and maintain individual development plans for team members.
* Identify skill gaps and training needs and support the development of relevant technical and leadership capabilities.
* Perform quality checks and provide constructive feedback to team members.
* Recruit, select, onboard, and integrate new employees into the team.
* Help new team members become operational within expected onboarding timelines.
* Recognize high performance and acknowledge individual and team accomplishments.
* Build a professional and collaborative team culture based on open communication, mutual respect, knowledge sharing, and accountability.
* Suggest and organize team-building and employee-engagement activities.

**Customer and Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as a key technical and operational point of contact for customer and internal stakeholder discussions.
* Respond to customer-management inquiries and handle escalations or complaints professionally.
* Coordinate technical guidance, priorities, delivery activities, and resources for critical customer situations.
* Build effective working relationships with customers and internal delivery teams across APAC, EMEA, and AMER.
* Communicate technical issues and recommended solutions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Collaborate with relevant Infor teams to ensure coordinated execution of IMS customer commitments.

* Approximately 15 years of relevant professional experience.
* Strong hands-on technical experience with Infor LN.
* Demonstrated experience in LN development, extensions, and customizations.
* Working knowledge of LN integrations, with the ability to guide team members and coordinate technical issue resolution.
* Strong understanding of the Infor LN product and its technical capabilities.
* Experience leading and managing a technical team.
* Demonstrated people-management experience, including coaching, mentoring, delegation, performance support, and team development.
* Experience handling technical escalations and supporting complex customer requirements.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in an SLA-driven service-delivery environment.
* Ability to collaborate with functional, consulting, delivery, and third-party teams.
* Willingness and ability to work from the Hyderabad office under the IMS hybrid working model.
* Flexibility to work a nine-hour schedule extending up to approximately 11:00 or 11:30 p.m., based on the agreed shift and business requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in an IMS, managed-services, production-support, or SLA-based delivery environment.
* Experience executing or overseeing IMS customer contracts.
* Experience supporting a large, geographically distributed customer portfolio.
* Experience working with customers and stakeholders across APAC, EMEA, and AMER.

**About The Role**
Here at Tide, we are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Team Leader to oversee our Acquiring Transaction Monitoring team in our first line of defence with experience in transaction monitoring within the card acquiring space or merchant banking, with a deep understanding of fraud detection, compliance, and risk management. This role requires strong leadership skills, along with a deep understanding of fraud prevention, risk management, and compliance within the payments ecosystem.
  
  
Your team will be responsible for the monitoring of the transaction and behaviours across our customer base, ensuring we put our genuine members first, whilst spotting and investigating potentially suspicious activity. This role is a key element of our team, so we’re looking for someone who is a passionate investigator, possesses good knowledge on merchant payments, who will help reduce risk to tide, and let our members get back to doing what they love.
  
  

* Lead, manage, and mentor a team of Transaction Monitoring Analysts, ensuring they meet performance metrics, including transaction reviews, case resolution times, and fraud detection accuracy.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and develop individual training plans to improve team capabilities.
* Manage resources of the team by effective capacity forecasting and monitoring, setting priorities, work allocation and reallocation where necessary.
* Supervise the monitoring of acquiring transactions, ensuring suspicious activities are detected in real-time or through post-transaction analysis.
* Oversee the monitoring of merchant acquiring activities, including card payment authorizations, settlements, chargebacks, and disputes, ensuring all processes follow best practices.
* Ensure all monitored transactions comply with industry regulations and standards, including AML, and card network rules (Visa, MasterCard, etc.).
* Develop strategies to reduce fraudulent activities across merchant card payments and ensure merchants meet compliance requirements.
* Use data-driven insights to recommend improvements in transaction monitoring processes and fraud mitigation strategies.
* Keep the team updated on emerging fraud trends and adjust detection rules and constantly measure, assess and improve our risk policies, procedures and controls across products
* Foster a collaborative team environment focused on continuous improvement and high operational efficiency.
* Representing your area in front of different stakeholders, including internal and external auditors.

**What We Are Looking For**

* You are willing to work in flexible shift patterns.
* 3-5 years of experience in merchant banking, card acquiring, merchant acquiring, transaction monitoring, or merchant card payments with automated processes and data driven decisioning tools/culture.
* Proven leadership experience, with a track record of managing teams in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
* Deep understanding of card acquiring processes, merchant acquiring systems, payment networks (Visa, MasterCard, etc.), and fraud detection methodologies.
* Analytical mindset with a proven ability to interpret complex transaction data and identify fraud patterns.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience in handling escalations and coordinating cross-functional teams.
* Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
  
  
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
  
  
*At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.*

title: Senior Manager, IT Delivery
description:
As a senior technology leader within Vanguard Technology, you will be responsible for defining and executing technology strategies that enable business growth, operational excellence and customer value. You will oversee teams responsible for designing, developing, testing, implementing and supporting enterprise technology solutions across multiple product and engineering domains. This role exists to ensure Vanguard continues to build scalable, resilient and innovative technology capabilities while accelerating delivery and strengthening engineering maturity. You will influence strategic technology direction, drive organisational effectiveness and create an environment where teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate and deliver meaningful outcomes. Success in this role requires strong leadership across technology, people, delivery, finance and stakeholder management. You will be expected to lead through transformation, develop future leaders and establish modern engineering practices that support Vanguard's evolving technology landscape.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
As a senior technology leader within Vanguard Technology, you will be responsible for defining and executing technology strategies that enable business growth, operational excellence and customer value. You will oversee teams responsible for designing, developing, testing, implementing and supporting enterprise technology solutions across multiple product and engineering domains.
  
  
This role exists to ensure Vanguard continues to build scalable, resilient and innovative technology capabilities while accelerating delivery and strengthening engineering maturity. You will influence strategic technology direction, drive organisational effectiveness and create an environment where teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate and deliver meaningful outcomes.
  
  
Success in this role requires strong leadership across technology, people, delivery, finance and stakeholder management. You will be expected to lead through transformation, develop future leaders and establish modern engineering practices that support Vanguard's evolving technology landscape.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
  

* Provide strategic leadership for technology delivery across multiple engineering, platform and product domains, ensuring alignment with business objectives and long-term technology strategy.
* Lead teams responsible for designing, developing, testing, implementing and supporting enterprise technology products and services.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to define priorities, shape technology demand and execute strategic roadmaps that drive business outcomes.
* Develop and implement workforce, operating and organisational growth plans that support business expansion and long-term capability development.
* Hire, coach, mentor and develop technology professionals and leaders while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation and continuous improvement.
* Establish and optimise operating models, governance frameworks and delivery processes that improve organisational effectiveness and execution excellence.
* Oversee planning, prioritisation, resource allocation and execution of complex technology initiatives and portfolios.
* Drive engineering transformation through adoption of modern software development practices, automation, platform engineering and AI-enabled delivery capabilities.
* Monitor delivery performance, service metrics and operational effectiveness using data-driven insights to improve outcomes and decision making.
* Lead the evaluation, selection, implementation and integration of technology solutions, vendor platforms and third-party products.
* Manage departmental budgets, workforce investments and technology expenditures while ensuring efficient use of resources.
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with business leaders, technology partners, vendors and key stakeholders to enable successful business outcomes.
* Identify organisational, operational, technology and delivery risks and implement effective mitigation strategies.
* Embed cybersecurity, resiliency, compliance and risk-management practices into technology solutions and engineering processes.
* Ensure adherence to information technology, cybersecurity and information security standards, policies and regulatory requirements.
* Lead quality and service-improvement initiatives that enhance engineering effectiveness, customer outcomes and operational excellence.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum 12+ years of experience in technology delivery, software engineering, programme management or technology leadership roles.
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading managers, engineering teams or large-scale technology organisations.
* Proven experience leading enterprise software delivery and technology transformation initiatives within complex global or matrixed organisations.
* Strong experience in technology strategy, organisational scaling, workforce planning, stakeholder management and operational leadership.
* Experience managing large technology portfolios, budgets, investment planning and resource allocation.
* Demonstrated experience evaluating technology platforms, managing vendor relationships and leading build-versus-buy decisions.
* Strong understanding of software delivery methodologies, engineering best practices, governance frameworks and operational excellence.
* Experience incorporating cybersecurity, resiliency, compliance and risk management requirements into technology solutions and delivery processes.
* Excellent communication, leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior business and technology leaders.
* Proven ability to lead through ambiguity, organisational change and rapid growth while maintaining delivery excellence.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, Business Administration or a related field.
* Experience leading large-scale engineering organisations within financial services, asset management or other highly regulated industries.
* Experience driving enterprise-wide engineering transformation, cloud modernisation and platform engineering initiatives.
* Experience implementing automation, AI-enabled engineering practices and emerging technology solutions.
* Knowledge of enterprise architecture, cloud technologies, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and secure software development practices.
* Experience working within global capability centres or globally distributed technology organisations.
* Professional certifications related to cloud technologies, programme management, agile delivery, cybersecurity or enterprise architecture.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

The Tax Process Strategy & Solutions Manager supports process leads and the Tax Practice to understand how one or more product(s) fit into the overall “vision” for one or more business area(s). + Designs and develops workpapers, data mappings, and other tax specific deliverables and content within applications, actively using expertise in accounting, tax, and the tax engagement lifecycle.
+ Elicit, gather and define business needs and prioritize functional business requirements with BAs
+ Conduct tax research on tax technical topics and determine process implications
+ Maintain currency of integrations with other solutions and assists in the pertinent testing

* Coordinates with RSM product team or vendor to understand new features/functionality and works with Change Management, process leads, and business teams to socialize the timing of new capabilities and how they fit into end-to-end process.

* Acts as a key contact for internal stakeholders and clients on complex tax technology matters, resolving issues with autonomy.
* Partners with Change Management and practice leaders to help lead implementation and ongoing adoption of products.
* Serves as a Performance Advisor to Associates and Senior Associates providing coaching, feedback, and development support.

**Education / Certification Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree (preference given to accounting, business or technology major)
* Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Chartered Accountant (CA), Enrolled Agent (EA) or JD, or actively pursuing

**Job Requirements**

* Minimum of 10 years’ experience having done tax compliance and advisory for high net-worth individuals within mid to large size public account firms (required).
* Must be capable of dealing confidently and professionally at executive level and with customers (required).
* Results driven; high integrity; ability to influence, negotiate and build relationships; superior communications skills; make complex decisions and manage change (required).
* Effective communication skills for differing audiences and situations (required).
* Tax compliance or advisory experience with deep expertise in accounting or tax fundamentals (required)
* Proficient in individual and fiduciary taxation, with an understanding of complex investments (e.g., real estate, fund of funds, hedge funds, private equity) and their implications (required), such as but not limited to the following:

+ Multiple activity streams with differing passive/non-passive and NII determinations
+ Partnership basis and pertinent limitations
+ Passive activity losses (Form 8582)
+ Trader income and materially participating real estate professional rules
+ Net investment income tax / Form 8960
+ Section 199A / QBI deduction
+ Foreign tax credit / Form 1116
+ International disclosures: Forms 926, 8621, 8938, 8865
+ Trust accounting / figuring distributable net income

title: Engineering Site Lead – Drug Product Facility
description:
**Position Title :**
Engineering Site Lead – Drug Product Facility

**Reports To :**
Head of Engineering – Vaccines Business Vertical

**Function :**
Engineering & Maintenance

**Location :**
Genome Valley,
Shamirpet \_SEZ Hyderabad

**Facility Type :**
Drug Product (DP) manufacturing – supporting CDMO operations

**Areas of Scope**

Formulation, Filling, Packing, Warehouse, QC, Utilities etc

**Team**

Large, multi-disciplinary engineering & maintenance organization

**Role Purpose**

Lead the complete engineering and maintenance function for a Drug Product (DP) manufacturing site operating within a Vaccine MFG /CDMO environment, ensuring reliable, compliant, and cost-effective operation of all process areas and utilities. The role owns asset reliability, GMP engineering compliance, expansion project delivery, and the development of a large multi-disciplinary engineering team, with the mandate to build a world-class maintenance culture that consistently meets client, quality, and regulatory expectations.

**Scope of Responsibility**

The role provides engineering leadership and maintenance support across the full DP value chain and site infrastructure:

* **Process & support areas:**
  formulation, aseptic/sterile filling, packing, warehouse, QC laboratories, and the complete utilities envelope.
* **Utilities:**
  HVAC and cleanrooms, purified water / WFI, clean steam, compressed air and process gases, chilled water, BMS/EMS, and power distribution.
* **Projects:**
  engineering scope on capital projects is limited to expansion projects (capacity additions, line/area upgrades, and de-bottlenecking) rather than new greenfield facility builds.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Maintenance & Asset Reliability**

* Establish and drive a world-class maintenance system built on preventive, predictive, and reliability-centered maintenance (RCM), TPM, and a mature CMMS.
* Improve equipment reliability, OEE, and MTBF/MTTR; minimize unplanned downtime and breakdowns.
* Own spares strategy, criticality analysis, and asset lifecycle / obsolescence management for all critical equipment.

**GMP Compliance & Quality**

* Ensure all engineering activities meet cGMP, data integrity, and regulatory expectations (USFDA, EMA, WHO, and other applicable agencies).
* Own the qualification and validation lifecycle (URS, DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ), calibration, change control, and computerized system compliance.
* Lead engineering readiness for regulatory, corporate, and client/CDMO audits; own and close engineering CAPAs on time.

**Expansion Projects & Engineering**

* Plan and deliver site expansion and upgrade projects on time, within budget, and to defined quality and compliance standards.
* Manage design, procurement, commissioning, qualification, and handover in coordination with global engineering, project, and client teams.

**Utilities & Facilities**

* Ensure uninterrupted, qualified operation of all clean and black utilities and controlled cleanroom environments.
* Drive energy efficiency, sustainability, and utility cost optimization.

**EHS, Budget & Cost**

* Embed a strong safety culture; ensure compliance with EHS regulations, permit-to-work systems, and risk assessments.
* Own the site engineering opex and capex budgets; drive cost optimization without compromising compliance or reliability.

**Leadership Responsibilities**

* Lead a large, multi-disciplinary engineering organization across process areas, disciplines, and shifts.
* Build capability through structured training, succession planning, and talent development; grow future engineering leaders.
* Set direction, KPIs, and performance standards; foster accountability, ownership, and a continuous-improvement mindset.
* Act as the site's senior engineering leader and a key member of the site leadership team.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary engineering interface for internal customers / CDMO clients on technical, reliability, and project matters, building trust and credibility.
* Partner closely with Production, Quality, Supply Chain, Projects, and EHS to align engineering priorities with site and business goals.
* Manage relationships with the engineering function, OEMs, contractors, and service providers.
* Represent engineering in client reviews, audits, and business meetings; communicate clearly across technical and leadership audiences.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's / Master's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, or Chemical Engineering.
* 15–20+ years of pharmaceutical / biopharma / vaccine engineering experience, with significant exposure to sterile/aseptic DP facilities.
* Proven track record of leading large engineering teams and building world-class maintenance systems.
* Strong knowledge of GMP, qualification/validation, sterile-manufacturing utilities, and regulatory audits.
* Experience in a CDMO or client-facing manufacturing environment strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success in delivering expansion / upgrade capital projects and driving reliability improvement.

**Key Competencies**

Strategic and hands-on engineering leadership; reliability and TPM mindset; regulatory and quality orientation; project management; financial acumen; excellent stakeholder and client management; and the ability to drive cultural change at scale.

description:
**Purpose**

The IT Service Manager – Network Operations is responsible for the effective delivery, reliability, and continual improvement of global network operations across all locations. This includes managing day-to-day operations, ensuring timely resolution of incidents and service requests, monitoring service health, and implementing enhancements to maintain security, compliance, and seamless connectivity experience.

Working closely with the accountable Service Owner, the IT Service Manager ensures network operations align with organizational goals and provides a consistent, secure, and high-performing infrastructure for all employees worldwide.

Stakeholders: Service Owners, Service Managers, Process Managers, Provider Managers, Regional Delivery Leads, and external partners.

* Oversee real-time monitoring tools for proactive detection of latency, jitter, and packet loss.
* Perform capacity planning for network infrastructure to support global scalability.
* Ensure integration with security platforms and compliance frameworks.

2. Vendor & Stakeholder Management

* Ensure compliance with global regulations and internal security policies.

* Perform cost analysis of global circuits, identifying opportunities for consolidation or migration.
* Manage budget allocations for hardware refresh cycles, licensing renewals, and carrier contracts.

Other responsibilities / duties as assigned.

title: Collateral Management - Manager
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
We are looking for a candidate with deep experience in Collateral Management to reduce credit risk by exchanging cash/securities with counterparties. Should have knowledge in the end to end functions including Onboarding activities ideally.
  
  
**Why This Role Is Important To Us**
Collateral management main focus is to reduce credit risk by exchanging eligible cash or securities between counterparties. The daily calculations are based on MTM of the underlying trades and results in sending Margin Calls, which in turn lead to agreeing transfers. Based on the agreements between our clients and the counterparties the Collateral team in India ensures that all the exposures are fully collateralized and the agreed collateral transactions settle as agreed. The critical onboarding process is particularly important.
  
  
**What you will be responsible for: As Officer you will:**

* End to End Margin call processing - Process daily margin calls daily for all agreed clients, who will include banks and fund clients and both cash and security margin calls.
* Reconcile collateral balances, investigate and solve discrepancies; be the main point of contact/ escalations
* Fails investigation - Checking the cash non-receipt reports and the custody settlement system (MCH) and initiating correspondence with the client
* Reporting - Generate a variety of reports, which includes client and internal reporting from an access database and Protocol.
* Portfolio reconciliations - Completing any daily or ad hoc manual portfolio reconciliations.
* Interest Processing - Month end interest statement generation, settling interest, updating interest agreements, and updating and validating interest rates.
* Ensure that the team meets accuracy and timeliness criteria.
* Carry out responsibilities fairly and impartially; create and maintain an engaged work environment.
* Assist in developing and implementing new workflow approaches and methods as well as system enhancements
* Collaborate with internal and external groups to identify, analyze and proactively resolve issues
* Be the key point of contact for internal/external clients in a most agile manner
* Provide inputs into hire, discipline, control work and terminate employment for direct reports and broader team as needed
* Provide inputs to promote, increase salary and bonus for direct reports and broader team as needed
* Provide coaching and development opportunities to staff
* Manage Performance Priorities and development plans
* Ensure SOPs/Job Aides/regulations are met and escalate as needed
* Comprehensive and demonstrated knowledge of overall process and operating model. Understand how Onboarding impacts OPS deliverables and plan to create an error free environment.
* Identify all risk issues, breaches and suspicious transactions and acts in accordance with the 'risk' escalation chain and operating procedures
* Execute on the risk framework changes and/or escalation chain changes. Ensure all Key controls are identified, implemented and adhered to
* Perform related duties as assigned (Projects - India and Global)
* Provide back and coverage as required across EMEA/NA shift

**What We Value**

* These skills will help you succeed in this role
* Communicates effectively and accurately in English - experience in facing clients
* Strong leadership, management, and organizational skills
* Ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines
* Ability to work on own initiative and proactive
* Very good management skills
* Self- motivated, flexible, personable
* Good interpersonal skills and an understanding of the rudimentary aspects of the global financial industry and also to Collateral Management would be advantageous

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Graduate and above preferably in Finance
* B.COM, BBM/BBA. MBA (Finance), M.COM or any degree related to Finance or Commerce

* Knowledge on Macros, SQL & MS Access Database queries

title: Data Center Inventory & Asset Technician Manager
description:
**Overview**
As a Microsoft Data Center Inventory & Asset Technician Manager (DIAM), you will lead a team of Inventory & Asset Management technicians across "multiple Data Centers" responsible for inbound/outbound logistics tasks, inventory cycle audits, and Data Center regulatory compliance activities. You will guide your employees to effectively run warranty processes and data bearing device (DBD) destruction. This opportunity will allow you to model leadership principles, drive focus on accurately and efficiently completing Inventory and Asset Management (IAM) tasks, and work with stakeholders to manage escalations.
  
  
Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DIAM, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.
  
  
Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
  
  
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* Graduate with 5+ year(s) experience warehouse/supply chain in an information technology (IT) environment, inventory management, retail, warehouse management, logistics, or a related field.

+ OR equivalent experience.

**Background Check Requirements**
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
  
  

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

While not required, we also look for the following
*Preferred Qualifications:*

* 5+ year(s) experience in warehouse/supply chain in an information technology (IT) environment, IT, and/or logistics, operating heavy-load movement equipment (e.g., forklift, pallet jacks, chassis lifts) for a large corporation

+ OR equivalent experience.

* 1+ year(s) project management experience.
* Certification in American Production and Inventory Control Society (APICS)/Association for Supply Chain Management (ASCM), International Association of Information Technology Asset Managers (IAITAM), Inventory Control, OR equivalent.

**Qualifications**
Responsibilities
  
  
Customer Service
  
  

* Ensures that all issues are documented, tracked, discussed, and resolved with internal and external stakeholders as well as suppliers with consistent and complete communication. Acts as a resource across Data Center teams (e.g., Site Services, Critical Environment, Facility Management, Security, Vendors, Safety, Supply Chain), and supports Microsoft and non-Microsoft gear deliveries. Drives focus on accurately and efficiently completing Inventory and Asset Management (IAM) tasks through a team up to headcount cap. Engages with internal and external stakeholders, maintaining relationships with vendors and providing oversight, to manage issues.

Data Bearing Device (DBD) Destruction
  
  

* Ensures all data bearing devices (DBDs) are destroyed within the allotted time, and all data bearing devices leaving premises do not contain customer information. Handles any escalations. Coordinates with and oversees any third-party vendors who perform DBD destruction as necessary, managing external vendor relationships. Maintains responsibility for any security investigations, partnering with security and senior leadership. Oversees data bearing devices (DBD) reconciliation and review of current documentation. Oversees decommissioning servers, ensuring proper documentation of actions taken against a decommissioning workflow and process standards are met.

Inbound and Outbound Logistics
  
  

* Leads a team of technicians responsible for preparing and executing incoming/outgoing deliveries and documenting inbound/outbound packages (e.g. purchase order [PO] receiving, Rack Movement Supervisor [RMS] activities) based on site-class designation. Responsible for overall day-to-day operations and ensures inbound and outbound measuring processes are running smoothly and effectively and inventory parts are properly stored. Ensures items logged within Intelligence Communication Manager (ICM) are resolved and deals with the escalated issues. Creates more efficient receiving routes, driving the movement of manual communication and information sharing to automated processes, managing the change.

IT Inventory Management
  
  

* Leads a team of technicians responsible for providing support guidance to third-party personnel, including material movement (e.g., inventory management/tracking, inventory staging), inventory cycle audits, and Data Center regulatory compliance or certification control audit activity. Enables strategies for space optimization, driving identification of opportunities to improve inventory to address space constraints, driving new build design and availability of inventory or storage rooms. Ensures escalations are resolved, and clears blocking issues to enable continued delivery of Inventory and Asset Management (IAM) activities.

Operational Excellence
  
  

* Serves as subject matter expert and models compliance to less experienced team members. Creates clarity and drives consistency in processes and services to align with defined policies and procedures in order to meet expectations for accuracy and timeliness of delivery. Drives improvement of delivered results against Service Level Agreements (SLAs), increasing efficiency of processes leading to Objective Key Results (OKRs). Collaborates with internal stakeholders to influence workstreams towards a more simplified and/or automated approach by evolving processes, services, and solutions to increase efficiency and manage costs. Drives environmental sustainability and zero waste initiatives. Ensures completion of required security and data management training and complies with security and data management procedures/policies. Oversees training for relevant site-specific procedures and tools (e.g., forklift, pallet jacks, technician on-hand processes, inventory maintenance software, RMA portals, Rack Movement).

People Management
  
  

* Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring. Model: Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles. Coach: Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn. Care: Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.

Safety Practices
  
  

* Runs daily safety topic huddles and conducts inspections of equipment (e.g., vehicles, pallet jacks, dock levelers). Manages and coordinates any escalated task risks and reported issues, establishing safety standard operating procedures for new equipment (e.g., server rack tugs, electric pallet jacks, forklifts). Trains employees on safe and effective equipment and inventory moving. Ensures team and 3rd party vendors are in compliance with Microsoft Corporation safety standards Procures, audits, and reviews personal protective equipment (PPE), leading by example of all safety standards. Presents Identity and Access Management (IAM) metrics to senior leaders. Supervises rack movement, observing to ensure compliance with safety protocols and training others on devices and tools used in rack movement. Oversees handling and storage of hazardous materials and chemicals, developing plans to address unsafe materials out of containment and ensuring preparedness of others, and acting as a point of escalation.

Krishna Jewellers Pearls & Gems Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced and business-oriented

to take complete ownership of the day-to-day operations and overall business performance of our jewellery showroom at Kokapet.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the store end to end, including
**Profit & Loss (P&L), sales performance, operational efficiency, inventory management, financial controls, staff productivity, customer experience, and compliance**
. The candidate must be capable of analyzing business performance, controlling costs, improving profitability, and ensuring smooth showroom operations while maintaining high standards of service and security.

Key Responsibilities

1. End-to-End Store Operations

* Take complete ownership of the showroom's daily operations and overall functioning.
* Ensure smooth coordination across sales, billing, inventory, customer service, and support functions.
* Establish and monitor operational processes, SOPs, and company policies.
* Ensure proper opening and closing procedures, staff deployment, housekeeping, and showroom readiness.
* Identify operational gaps and implement improvements to enhance efficiency and productivity.

2. Profit & Loss (P&L) and Financial Management

* Take ownership of the store's overall P&L, revenue, profitability, and operating expenses.
* Monitor sales, gross margins, discounts, operating costs, and other key financial performance indicators.
* Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly business performance reports.
* Develop action plans to achieve revenue, profitability, and cost-control targets.
* Monitor controllable expenses and ensure optimal utilization of store resources.
* Ensure accurate cash management, billing, payment reconciliation, and financial documentation.
* Analyze business variances and present performance updates and improvement plans to management.

3. Sales Performance and Business Growth

* Drive overall store revenue and profitability through effective business planning and execution.
* Set sales targets and monitor individual and team performance against business goals.
* Identify opportunities to improve conversion rates, average transaction value, repeat business, and customer footfall.
* Implement upselling and cross-selling strategies to improve sales and margins.
* Analyze product category performance and customer buying patterns to support business decisions.
* Develop local business opportunities and execute promotional activities in coordination with management and marketing teams.

4. Inventory and Stock Management

* Oversee end-to-end inventory management, including stock availability, movement, transfers, and reconciliation.
* Ensure accurate stock records and conduct regular physical stock audits.
* Monitor stock discrepancies, ageing inventory, slow-moving items, and stock loss.
* Coordinate with merchandising, purchase, and inventory teams to maintain appropriate stock levels.
* Ensure strict controls over jewellery handling, custody, security, and documentation.
* Investigate stock variances and implement corrective measures to minimize losses.

5. Team Management and Productivity

* Lead and manage the complete showroom team, including sales staff, billing personnel, and support staff.
* Plan manpower requirements, duty rosters, attendance, and task allocation.
* Set performance expectations and monitor individual productivity.
* Train and coach employees on operational procedures, product knowledge, customer handling, and compliance.
* Conduct performance reviews and implement improvement plans where required.
* Maintain discipline, accountability, teamwork, and a performance-driven work culture.

6. Compliance, Controls, and Risk Management

* Ensure adherence to company policies, internal controls, and applicable statutory requirements.
* Maintain accurate operational, financial, inventory, and employee records.
* Ensure compliance with billing, cash handling, stock movement, and authorization procedures.
* Coordinate internal audits and implement corrective actions for audit observations.
* Enforce showroom security, loss-prevention measures, and risk-control procedures.
* Ensure proper documentation and timely closure of operational issues.

7. Customer Experience and Relationship Management

* Ensure a consistent, high-quality customer experience throughout the showroom.
* Handle customer escalations, complaints, and service recovery.
* Build relationships with high-value and repeat customers.
* Monitor customer feedback and implement measures to improve satisfaction and retention.
* Ensure the showroom maintains premium presentation, cleanliness, and visual merchandising standards.

8. Reporting and Coordination with Management

* Submit regular reports on sales, P&L, expenses, inventory, manpower, and operational performance.
* Review key performance indicators and take timely corrective action.
* Coordinate with finance, HR, inventory, marketing, and other departments to resolve store-related issues.
* Provide business insights, market intelligence, competitor updates, and recommendations to management.
* Take accountability for achieving the showroom's overall business and operational objectives.

Qualifications & Skills

* Strong understanding of retail store operations, financial management, and business performance.
* Proven experience in P&L management, budgeting, cost control, and profitability improvement.
* Knowledge of inventory control, stock audits, cash management, and internal controls.
* Strong leadership, decision-making, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to interpret sales reports, financial statements, and operational MIS.
* Proficiency in POS systems, MS Excel, and inventory or retail management software.
* Strong communication, coordination, and team management skills.
* High integrity, accountability, and attention to detail.

Education & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Retail Management, Finance, or a related field preferred.
* **Minimum 10 years of overall retail experience, including at least 5 years in a Store Manager or equivalent leadership role.**
* Experience managing the complete operations and P&L of a retail store is strongly preferred.
* Experience in jewellery, luxury retail, fashion, lifestyle, or other high-value retail businesses will be an advantage.
* Candidates with demonstrated experience in inventory control, financial management, operational audits, and profitability improvement will be preferred.

Working Conditions

* 6 days per week.
* 10 working hours per day.
* Availability to work on weekends, public holidays, and during festive seasons.
* Active involvement in showroom operations and business reviews.

Compensation & Benefits

* Competitive salary.
* Performance-based incentives.
* Health insurance and Provident Fund (PF).
* Paid leave.
* Daily snacks.
* Yearly bonus.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.
* Supportive and professional work environment.

**Key Expectation:**
The Store Manager will act as the overall business owner of the showroom, ensuring complete accountability for store operations, P&L, profitability, inventory, team performance, compliance, and customer experience.

The company designs, develops, and manufactures high-quality electric scooters tailored to the diverse needs of customers. Backed by over five decades of automotive expertise, Quantum Energy operates a state-of-the-art R&D center and advanced manufacturing facility in Hyderabad to deliver innovative and sustainable mobility solutions. The Battery Production Manager is responsible for overseeing end-to-end battery production operations for electric scooters at Quantum Energy Limited. title: Catering & Events Associate
description:
Are you passionate about creating exceptional food experiences and unforgettable events? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, people-centric environment where no two days are the same? If you have a flair for hospitality, a sharp eye for detail, and a love for bringing people together — we want to hear from you!
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Catering & Events Associate at Swiss Re, you will be at the heart of our workplace experience, delivering world-class food & beverage services and orchestrating seamless corporate events. From strategic planning to hands-on execution, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the day-to-day hospitality experience for our employees and guests in Hyderabad. This is your opportunity to combine your passion for food, events, and people into a role that truly makes an impact.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design and execute food & beverage strategies that align with organizational standards and cater to the diverse needs of our internal customers
* Champion sustainable gastronomy practices, driving initiatives that align with our environmental and organizational objectives
* Plan and manage end-to-end corporate events, including developing event plans, timelines, and conducting venue inspections and evaluations
* Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors — including kitchen staff, caterers, decorators, and audiovisual providers — to ensure timely and flawless service delivery
* Ensure full compliance with ISO 22000 and all applicable food safety, health & safety regulations, licensing, tax obligations, and labour laws
* Organise FOSTAC training for all food handlers and manage Background Verification documentation
* Create and manage budgets, track financial performance, analyse trends, and prepare regular financial and dashboard reports
* Build and nurture strong vendor and partner relationships, negotiating contracts and establishing KPIs to ensure cost-effectiveness and service excellence
* Drive process improvement initiatives, including automation and streamlining operations to enhance efficiency and overall experience
* Gather and act on feedback from employees and guests to continuously elevate the hospitality and events experience
* Lead and develop contract staff, fostering a positive, collaborative, and high-performing team culture
* Stay current with industry trends and best practices in catering, sustainable gastronomy, and event management

**About The Team**
The Corporate Real Estate and Services (CRES) team is on a mission to create and sustain a world-class office environment that aligns with Swiss Re's strategic vision and goals. Our diverse team of experts spans real estate, security, facilities management, and hospitality operations — working collaboratively to deliver innovative, data-driven solutions that make a real difference.
  
  
We believe that a well-maintained, secure, and thoughtfully designed workspace — paired with exceptional service offerings — is a powerful driver of employee well-being and productivity. As trusted advisors and partners, we are committed to consistently exceeding service standards by leveraging our collective expertise, fostering open communication, and embracing continuous learning and improvement.
  
  
**About You**
You are a hospitality professional who leads with warmth, precision, and purpose. You bring a solution-focused mindset, a genuine passion for customer service, and the ability to manage multiple priorities with grace. You take full ownership and accountability for your work, demonstrating strong leadership in everything you do — whether managing a high-profile event or resolving a day-to-day operational challenge. You thrive in dynamic environments, build strong relationships effortlessly, and are always looking for smarter, better ways to deliver exceptional experiences.
  
  
**We Are Looking For Candidates Who Meet These Requirements**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in catering, food & beverage management or a related corporate role, with demonstrated experience managing large teams
* Strong knowledge of food safety regulations, including ISO 22000 standards, and experience implementing and enforcing safe food handling procedures
* Proven budget management and financial analysis skills, with the ability to create, oversee, and report on budgets and financial performance
* Experience in vendor and contract management, including negotiating contracts and managing relationships with external partners and suppliers
* Proficiency in event planning and execution, including developing event plans, timelines, and coordinating with multiple internal and external stakeholders
* Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and leadership skills — the ability to take responsibility for outcomes, lead by example, and drive results even in ambiguous or challenging situations

Reporting & Analytics

 Leadership \& Collaboration

 People Leadership:

 SkinBae is building a curated Korean skincare platform in India. We work closely with global Korean beauty brands and focus on education\-led storytelling, strong visual identity, and long\-term brand building across D2C, marketplaces, and offline retail.

title: Diamond Jewelry Retail : Store Manager
description:
**Company Description** 




 House of Quadri is a contemporary lab\-grown diamond jewelry brand based in Mumbai, India. The company designs, manufactures, and directly retails its jewelry, maintaining close control over quality and craftsmanship. As a small, dynamic team, House of Quadri is building a direct\-to\-consumer brand with an online\-first approach. Team members work in an environment that values innovation, modern aesthetics, and customer\-centric thinking. The company offers opportunities to contribute to a growing brand at the intersection of jewelry, fashion, and technology.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The Store Manager role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. The Store Manager will oversee daily store operations, including opening and closing procedures, visual merchandising, inventory management, and coordination with the production and online teams. This role involves leading and training store staff, ensuring high standards of customer service, and maintaining a welcoming, brand\-aligned store environment.
 



  





 The Store Manager will manage sales targets, track performance, handle customer inquiries and escalations, and support in\-store events or promotions. The role also includes monitoring product quality, coordinating quality checks/repairs as needed, and providing feedback to design and manufacturing teams to enhance the customer experience.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess skills in diamond jewelry product and an understanding of pricing ind detail.
* Candidates should possess strong customer service skills, including client engagement, relationship\-building, and after\-sales support.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of basic jewelry finishing standards to ensure product quality on the sales floor.
* Candidates should possess training and team leadership skills to coach staff, conduct product and service trainings, and maintain performance standards.
* Relevant experience in retail store management, preferably in jewelry, luxury, or fashion, is highly beneficial.
* Strong communication, organizational, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work in a collaborative environment.
* Comfort with digital tools, CRM, POS systems, and coordination with online sales or e\-commerce channels.
* A diploma or degree in retail management, business, fashion, or a related field is an advantage.

title: Fund Services Assistant Manager
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different \- in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
 As a member of the Private Equity team, you will be accountable for an efficient processing and review of end\-to\-end PE funds NAV delivery, including capital events, annual financials, support year end audit process and specifically supports the team during process migration to India CDC and overseeing the NAV delivery:
   

  

* Supervise and mentor a team of Fund Accountants and Senior Fund Accountants, ensuring strong technical capability and client service orientation
* Oversee quarterly and annual financial statements under US GAAP/IFRS, including partner capital accounts and waterfall allocations.
* Review and approve capital activity (calls, distributions, equalizations) and ensure compliance with side letters and bespoke investor economics
* Implement and monitor internal controls for an efficient NAV accounting process and exception management to maintain audit readiness
* Identify and execute process improvements to reduce cycle times and enhance reporting accuracy
* Support system optimization initiatives (Investran, Allvue, and other Nav accounting tools) and other NAV process automation projects
* Sign off as reviewer on SOC1 checklist and support SOC external audit requests
* Ensure compliance with internal audit procedures and requests
* Develop leadership skills by demonstrating willingness to lead projects and offer input; and
* Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of the governing agreement(s) between Alter Domus, the clients and their investors
* Foster a culture of accountability, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.


**YOUR PROFILE**
* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in accounting, Finance, any other professional accounting qualification (i.e. CA, CMA or ACCA or equivalent)
* Minimum of 10\+ years’ experience in accounting for the financial services sector, particularly Private Equity, Asset Management or Fund Administration.
* Supervisory skills with experience in managing and/or leading staff for 3\-4 years and should have conducted minimum 1 performance appraisal cycle for junior staff
* Private equity fund experience, Exposure to complex fund structures
* Expertise in US GAAP/IFRS, waterfall mechanics, carried interest, and investor economics.
* Familiarity with PE accounting platforms (Investran, Allvue) is highly preferred
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to perform multiple projects, navigate unexpected challenges, and bring about viable solutions that provide the best results.


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**
* Support for professional accreditations such as ACCA and study leave
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location


 Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
   

  

 (Alter Domus Privacy notice can be reviewed via Alter Domus webpage: https://alterdomus.com/privacy\-notice/)

title: Quality Manager IRC298730
description:
**Description**
 GlobalLogic is looking for a detail\-oriented Quality Management professional with strong expertise in quality assurance, audit frameworks, performance management, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will be responsible for governing quality standards, monitoring operational performance, driving corrective actions, and ensuring consistent quality delivery across service operations.
   

  

**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Quality Management, or a related field.
* Proven experience in quality management, quality assurance, or operational excellence within a service industry.
* Experience managing quality performance.
* Strong knowledge of quality management systems, audit methodologies, and root cause analysis techniques.
* Proficiency in analyzing quality metrics, identifying trends, and driving improvement initiatives.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience leading and developing quality teams.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, and project management capabilities.
* Proficiency in reporting tools and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally and influence operational teams to achieve quality objectives.


 Job responsibilities
   

  

  

* Define and govern quality standards, processes, and audit frameworks for quality operations.
* Monitor quality performance through audits, scorecards, and key quality metrics.
* Identify quality risks, analyze error trends, and drive root cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with client requirements, operational procedures, and contractual quality commitments.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce defects and enhance overall quality performance.
* Drive training, calibration, and capability\-building programs based on quality findings.
* Provide regular quality reporting and insights to operational and client stakeholders.
* Manage and develop the quality team to ensure consistent and effective quality oversight.
* Work closely with internal and external stakeholders on deliverables.
* Prepare and present reports on quality metrics, performance, and improvement initiatives.


 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Manager - Direct and FC&L Procurement
description:
**Build Our Future Together**
 At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life\-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking a Manager, Direct Materials Procurement to join our Global Procurement team, supporting our India operations in a hybrid work model. In this role, you will drive category strategy, sourcing, and supplier performance for direct materials while collaborating with cross\-functional partners and global procurement colleagues. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a fast\-growing, science\-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.
   

  

**When \& Where**
 Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)
   

  

**Discover Your Role**
* Drive the definition and implementation of global direct material category strategies aligned to regional and global business needs
* Partner with collaborators to manage category priorities, sourcing decisions, and procurement activities across direct materials
* Lead negotiations, contracting, and supplier management to deliver cost savings, cash flow improvements, and operational efficiencies
* Ensure category activities align with GxP and applicable regulatory standards
* Collaborate with Legal to negotiate contract terms and conditions aligned to business requirements
* Use market intelligence, supplier insights, and data analytics to inform decision\-making and improve category performance
* Contribute to organizational decisions and initiatives that shape global procurement capabilities and category outcomes
* You operate effectively in a matrixed, global environment and build strong, trusted relationships with internal and external partners.


**This Role Requires**
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field with progressive experience in procurement, including Pharma/Biopharma.
* Proven experience managing category strategies, sourcing, contracting, and supplier relationships across direct materials or related categories.
* Strong negotiation capability with understanding of cost structures, rates, and supply market dynamics.
* Demonstrated success working with cross\-functional teams to deliver results across procurement activities.
* Experience supporting supplier evaluation processes using market intelligence, risk, compliance, and financial assessment tools.
* Knowledge of global procurement processes and operating models within the biopharmaceutical industry.
* Ability to demonstrate data and analytics to drive category decisions and project outcomes
* Experience managing or coaching professional\-level employees preferred.
* Working knowledge of sourcing and contracting tools, ERP systems, and eRFx platforms (e.g., Oracle, Zycus, Ariba) preferred.
* Proficiency in standard business applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
