title: Vulnerability Management Program + Anthropic - Manager
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Join Deloitte Cyber to help clients identify, assess, and reduce exposure across their digital environment. As a Manager, you will lead vulnerability management and attack surface management efforts by driving program execution, improving visibility into asset risk, and helping stakeholders prioritize remediation actions. You will work with global teams, enterprise security tools, and reporting frameworks to strengthen cyber situational awareness and support resilient operations.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Manager on the Cyber Defense \& Resilience team, you will be responsible for…
   

  

* Lead the design, implementation, and day\-to\-day management of vulnerability management activities across client environments
* Develop and maintain policies, standards, procedures, and reporting processes for vulnerability assessment, prioritization, and remediation
* Oversee scanning, testing, and analysis activities using enterprise tools to identify vulnerabilities, rogue assets, and exposure trends
* Communicate risk posture, remediation progress, and key metrics to technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying asset data gaps, supporting program reporting, and advancing the vulnerability management roadmap


**The team**
 Cyber Defense \& Resilience teams assist clients in identifying, prioritizing, and remediating vulnerabilities across their digital ecosystem through robust Attack Surface Management (ASM). By continuously monitoring client environments—networks, applications, cloud assets, and endpoints—they proactively uncover potential exposure points before threat actors can exploit them. Attack Surface Management (ASM) is a foundational capability within the Cyber Defense \& Resilience portfolio, enabling proactive identification and mitigation of security vulnerabilities across an organization’s digital landscape.
   

  

**Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai**
**Shift Timings: General**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 9\+ years of experience in vulnerability management, information security, application security, or technical cybersecurity roles
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), or GIAC Continuous Monitoring Certification (GMON)
* Experience designing or managing vulnerability management programs
* Experience conducting vulnerability analysis using Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or similar tools
* Experience with networking protocols, including Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), Domain Name System (DNS), and Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP)
* Experience using Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) and Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) frameworks


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience developing metrics, dashboards, or executive reporting on vulnerability status and remediation progress
* Experience with asset provisioning or deprovisioning lifecycle processes
* Experience with patch management tools such as Microsoft Intune or Red Hat Satellite
* Experience analyzing malicious code activity, distributed denial of service (DDoS), or network scanning activity
* Experience with Confluence, Jira, or Configuration Management Databases (CMDBs) such as ServiceNow
* Experience with databases, query design, or data analysis


 \#FY27CyberCampaign

title: Operations Consultant
description:
**Role: Operations Consultant** 




  





**Who We Are:** 




 Streamliners is a management consulting firm specialized in rapid efficiency improvements, operational excellence, and fast turnaround. We help manufacturers and private equity owned portfolio companies in North America and Europe solve complex operational challenges to maximize profit margins and gain competitive advantage. At our core, we are doers. We work closely with clients in various industries to execute the steps required to achieve performance improvements.
 



  





**Who You Are:** 




 A experienced and self\-directed problem solver. A change management champion. You not only work well with others, but also can operate autonomously with little direction. You go the extra mile, and your entrepreneurial drive and intellectual curiosity have helped you garner a track\-record of achievement.
 



  





 You should feel second nature conducting \& leading the following analysis:
 


* Process Capacity \& Utilization Modeling
* Bottleneck Analysis
* Waste Reduction
* Warehouse Restructuring
* KPI Creation
* Root Cause Analysis
* Workforce Analysis



  





**The Role:** 




 You will work alongside other consultants and clients, typically on site, to deliver transformation objectives. You will have ownership of workstreams and be responsible for executing effective improvement plans within operations, ranging from shop floor improvements to fundamental changes in work processes and information and material flows. You’ll also serve clients in a project manager capacity for turnarounds, transformations, and expansions.
 



  





**Duties / Responsibilities:** 



* Serve as project leader for project workstreams, transformations, and turnarounds
* Problem\-solve technical manufacturing issues using structured methodologies
* Use facts and data to prioritize improvement opportunities
* You will adopt a process\-oriented approach to solving problems and will break a large complex problem into a series of smaller, more manageable modules.
* Drive change and improvements to the overall execution of client operations
* Transform manufacturing processes for better productivity and efficiency
* Conduct due diligence, benchmarking, best practice, and other assessment studies
* Recommend actions and help clients implement them
* Manage and deliver the highest quality client work



  





**Qualifications:** 



* 4\+ years of experience in a high\-performance manufacturing environment
* 3\+ years leadership and management experience
* Bachelor’s degree (Master’s preferred) in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics), Operations, or Business
* Strong functional knowledge in one or more of the following: discrete manufacturing, project management, process automation, continuous improvement
* Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with people at all levels in an organization
* Strong communication and organizational skills

 Event Production Manager → Senior Production Manager → Production Lead → Event Operations Manager

title: Shift Manager
description:
**Business Unit:**
 Cubic Transportation Systems
   

  

**Company Details:**
 When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
   

  

 We have a top\-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.
   

  

**Job Details:**
**Job Summary**
 As a Shift Coordinator on the CTS 24x7 Service Operations team, you will provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 staff across the Network Operations Center (NOC), Security Operations Center (SOC), and Service Desk during your assigned shift. You act as the technical and operational command authority during the shift. You are responsible for ensuring that events across all three functions are correctly triaged, tickets are properly assigned and tracked, incidents are escalated per defined protocols, and shift handovers preserve full situational awareness for the incoming shift.
   

  

 You are responsible for confirming shift staffing coverage in real time and for adjusting assignments to accommodate last\-minute absences. You are the immediate escalation path for issues that exceed the authority of the Tier 1 and Tier 2 analysts on the shift, and you escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for issues that exceed shift authority.
   

  

 Work is conducted under the compliance frameworks that govern CTS operations, in particular ITIL 4 (Monitoring and Event Management, Incident Management, Continual Improvement), ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (Annex A logging, monitoring, and incident management controls), and PCI DSS v4\.0\.1 (Requirements 10 and 12\.10\). You will be recognized inside CTS as the shift\-level owner for cross\-function coordination and evidence continuity.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities**
**Shift Command and Team Coordination**
* Provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 NOC, SOC, and Service Desk analysts during the assigned shift.
* Assign work at shift start and re\-balance workload throughout the shift based on ticket volume, incident severity, and individual analyst capacity.
* Confirm complete shift coverage across NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues at shift start; adjust in real time when staff are unavailable because of sick calls, unplanned PTO, or emergency absence.
* Serve as the initial escalation point for any Tier 1 or Tier 2 analyst who needs additional authority, judgment, or cross\-functional coordination.
* Track and report shift\-level metrics (ticket volume, SLA adherence, incident count by severity) at shift close.


**Shift Handover Discipline**
* Execute a formal shift handover at the start and end of every shift, per the protocols defined in the NOC Scope Definition and the CTS SOC Scope of Operations.
* Ensure the handover record captures, at minimum: open incidents with owner and next action; active containment actions in progress; watchlist items; active maintenance windows; tooling or coverage gaps.
* Retain handover records as ISMS evidence supporting ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.5\.10 and ITIL 4 Monitoring and Event Management practice.


**Incident Management Coordination**
* Apply ITIL 4 Incident Management practice throughout the shift: validate alerts, classify severity, assign ownership, coordinate escalation, and track resolution against SLA.
* Coordinate the first 15 to 30 minutes of any SEV 0 or SEV 1 incident: declare the incident, engage the appropriate tiers, initiate stakeholder communications, and hand off to the Incident Commander or on\-call Tier 3 engineer.
* Enforce severity special rules from the NOC Scope Definition (for example, loss of logging or monitoring is never a SEV 4 event; SEV 0 or SEV 1 with a recent production change requires a change correlation step).
* Ensure joint NOC\-SOC coordination during Major Incidents: NOC leads operational recovery; SOC leads security investigation and containment; the Shift Coordinator maintains the shared incident bridge until the Incident Commander takes over.


**Cross\-Function Ticket Routing and Escalation**
* Monitor NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues in the ITSM platform; ensure tickets are correctly categorized and assigned per the RACI.
* Route security\-relevant events from the NOC or Service Desk to the SOC per the defined Escalation pathway with enriched context.
* Route operational recovery actions from the SOC to the NOC or regional IT Operations per the defined protocol.
* Escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for any issue that exceeds shift authority.


**Compliance Evidence and Documentation**
* Ensure shift activities produce audit\-ready evidence supporting PCI DSS v4\.0\.1 Requirement 10 and Requirement 12\.10, and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.5\.24\-A.5\.28 and A.8\.15\-A.8\.16\.
* Verify handover records, incident timelines, and containment action logs are complete and accurate before shift close.
* Support monthly and quarterly evidence pack preparation.


**Continuous Improvement Contribution**
* Identify recurring patterns during the shift (repeat incidents, noisy alerts, gaps in playbook coverage) and log them for review by the NOC, SOC, and Service Desk Managers.
* Participate in post\-incident reviews and contribute to the Continual Improvement Register per ITIL 4 Continual Improvement practice.
* Recommend changes to shift\-level procedures where the shift experience identifies opportunities.


**General Duties And Responsibilities**
* Reliably demonstrate accountability for work assignments and proactive communications about issues and status. A strong history of proactively identifying effective solutions for challenges.
* Able to work effectively and uphold professional standards, with the customer and system stakeholders.
* Self\-motivated and able to work unsupervised.
* Methodical and attentive to detail.
* Proactive in seeking advice from senior operations and security subject matter experts when required.
* Comfortable working with staff at all levels and in other geographical locations within the organization.
* Comply with Cubic's Quality Management System.
* Comply with Cubic's quality, health, safety, and security policies.
* Support the company's strategic objectives and collaborate across departments.
* Comply with Cubic Human Resources Procedures.


**Skills / Experience / Knowledge**
**Essential:**
* Experience providing direct supervision to a team of individual contributors in a technology operations, security operations, or service desk environment.
* Working knowledge of NOC operations: event monitoring, incident management, SLA management, change and configuration control.
* Working knowledge of SOC operations: SIEM and EDR alert triage, security incident classification, escalation protocols.
* Working knowledge of Service Desk operations under a Tier 1\-3 tiered model.
* Familiarity with ITIL 4 practices, in particular Monitoring and Event Management and Incident Management.
* Ability to interpret and explain incident status, containment actions, and escalation decisions to peers, subordinate staff, and functional peer groups. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Collaboration and Interaction expectations.
* Sound judgment in resolving problems that require analysis of data and relevant factors under real\-time pressure. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Complexity and Problem Solving expectations.
* Ability to develop and manage routine operational plans and meet targets against a monthly performance plan. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Discretion and Impact expectations.
* Experience preparing accurate shift reports and handover records.
* Comfort operating 24x7 shift patterns, including nights, weekends, and public holidays.


**Desirable:**
* Familiarity with PCI DSS v4\.0\.1 requirements, in particular Requirement 10, Requirement 11\.5, and Requirement 12\.10\.
* Familiarity with ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A controls covering logging (A.8\.15\), monitoring activities (A.8\.16\), and incident management (A.5\.24 to A.5\.28\).
* Exposure to NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2\.0 (NIST CSWP 29\) Detect and Respond Functions.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow (or equivalent enterprise ITSM) and Jira.
* Understanding of the ITIL 4 Major Incident model and Problem Management practice.
* Experience coordinating across NOC, SOC, and Service Desk boundaries.


**Qualifications**
**Essential:**
* Must be able to work on\-site at Cubic Hyderabad, Aparna Plaza, on a 24x7 rotating shift pattern.
* Minimum 5\-8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree.
* University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or other technical field; or Business Administration with relevant IT work experience.
* At least 5 years of experience in a Tier 1\-3 operations environment (NOC, SOC, Service Desk, or NOC/SOC hybrid).
* At least 3 years’ experience managing shift workers.
* Demonstrated ability to make severity classification and escalation decisions in a real\-time operations setting.
* Demonstrated ability to lead a team through a shift, including workload assignment, coaching, and formal handover.
* At least 3 years’ experience working in an ITIL 4 operation.


**Desirable:**
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification; ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader preferred.
* CompTIA Security\+, ISC2 SSCP, or equivalent security operations certification.
* ServiceNow ITSM administrator or user certification.
* Experience in a payment card processing environment, or in a similarly regulated real\-time operations environment.
* Experience with global follow\-the\-sun shift models spanning NAM, EMEA, and APAC time zones.


**Condition of Employment:**
 Successful outcome of a National Police Check

 Employee

title: Clinical Trial Manager
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company’s patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.
   

  

 Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Clinical Trial Manager is responsible for leading the planning, execution, oversight, and delivery of early phase clinical trials. The CPM serves as the operational leader for assigned studies, partnering cross\-functionally with the Clinical Development Lead / Clinical Scientist, Drug Safety, Regulatory, Data Management, Quality, and external vendors to ensure clinical trials are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with applicable regulations and quality standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the operational execution of assigned domestic or global early phase clinical trial(s) including oversight of selected vendor(s)/CRO to ensure accountability, quality, and on time delivery of key project deliverables.
* Develop and manage study timelines, contract/budget negotiations, and risk mitigation plans to ensure delivery on timeline and financial goals are met.
* Initiate and manage request for proposal activities for assigned clinical studies or clinical development vendors, including CROs, specialty lab vendors, bioanalytical vendors, etc.
* Lead study execution team comprised of cross\-functional representatives from Regulatory, Drug Safety, Medical, Drug Supply, Data Management, Biostatistics, and Quality to oversee CRO vendors and ensure study excellence.
* Manage clinical development vendors according to vendor oversight plans.
* Oversee all study\-level data monitoring activities, reviews monitoring visit reports, and conducts Sponsor oversight monitoring visits as required.
* Responsible for monthly Protocol Deviation (PD) review, including oversight of CRA documentation and collaboration with Medical Monitor for medical review.
* Prepares and/or reviews study\-related study plans/documents; reviews site study documents.
* May assist in strategic trial design and protocol writing and reviewing / contributing to clinical regulatory documents to support upcoming programs (regulatory submissions, clinical overviews, pediatric study plans, etc.).
* Strategic country/site selection with program input and ensuring consistency across all clinical projects for therapeutic area.
* Ensures all clinical trials are executed in compliance with ICH/GCP guidelines/regulations and applicable SOPs: participates in the planning of quality assurance activities and coordinates resolution of audit findings; ensures audit\-ready condition of clinical trial documentation including central clinical files, Trial Master File (TMF), and clinical trial registry submissions.
* Ensure inspection readiness and compliance with ICH\-GCP, FDA, EMA, and applicable regulatory requirements.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 10 years minimum experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry including Contract Research Organization (CRO), pharmaceutical/biotechnology company, or clinical research environment (e.g., CRA, site coordinator, drug safety specialist, regulatory\-clinical specialist), including 5\+ years of clinical project/trial management (PM) or equivalent clinical operations experience.
* Knowledge of international regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, GCP, GMP, GDPR).
* Experience in and knowledge of the pharmaceutical development process


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years’ experience of clinical trial management for early phase studies conducted in the US and India
* Broad understanding of regulatory GMP requirements for IMP product packaging and supply
* Excellent organizational and leadership skills.
* Effective communicator who can manage multiple priorities while building strong internal relationships across multiple departments.


 By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

description:

 Join an inclusive team that is passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. Our business goals are directly tied to the value we place on our team members – our greatest asset. We invest in our people through a skills\-based learning and development model to create clear career pathways for development and career growth. We also strive to create an engaging and inclusive culture through building camaraderie and celebrating the diverse perspectives of all our global team members. Join us and discover why Micron’s Global Procurement team is the preferred destination to unleash your talent!
   

  

 As a GP COE Source\-to\-Pay (STP) Process Manager, you are responsible for working with the process owners to define and assess Global Procurement business processes through data gathering, analysis, and problem\-solving. You will support benchmarking activities across diverse sources, with the aim of harmonizing existing processes and driving process transformation to establish a best\-in\-class standard. You will formulate recommendations for performance improvement. You will lead and implement project plans of overall process improvement activities to meet business requirements and drive business results. You will engage leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders to drive adoption and achieve ongoing process improvement results.
   

  

**Process Transformation**
 Implement or lead complex, global and regional process transformation supporting Global Procurement.
   

  

 Guide cross\-organizational teams to define, build and implement business process solutions that increase efficiencies, improve standardization, and optimize procurement services.
   

  

 Drive benchmarking across various sources, standardize current processes and transform processes to set a best\-in\-class new standard.

 Analyze processes and propose changes or improvements to help achieve goals.
   

  

 Elevate process efficiency and drive transformation by applying appropriate continuous improvement tools and methodologies.
   

  

 Apply knowledge to provide consultation on Source\-to\-Pay processes.
   

  

 Leverage process mining tools (e.g., Celonis) to identify process bottlenecks, deviations, and improvement opportunities across Source\-to\-Pay workflows
   

  

 Use data\-driven insights from process mining and analytics to prioritize transformation initiatives and measure impact
   

  

**Leading through influence**
 Drive adoption with organizational change management methods and tools and capture project or program return of investment.
   

  

 Ability to encourage and persuade others to adopt the change required for a successful implementation of the project.
   

  

**Stakeholder Engagement**
 Develop positive relationships with stakeholders to enable a competitive advantage, achieving program and project objectives and successful implementation.
   

  

 Actively engage with procurement leadership and cross\-functional business clients to drive best in class methodology adoption, optimized system utilization, and continuous process improvement outcomes.
   

  

 Collaborate with stakeholders to drive adoption of AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives across procurement processes
   

  

**You Are**
 Well\-versed in project management skills and process management, procurement standard methodologies and technology to develop best\-in\-class results.
   

  

 Knowledgeable in Procurement business processes
   

  

 Proficient in continuous improvement tools and methodologies to elevate process efficiency and drive transformation.
   

  

 Demonstrate strong communication through active listening and clear communication to articulate complex problem statements concisely and accurately to all levels.
   

  

 Having a global perspective and a positive demeanor that is well\-suited for working across different regions.
   

  

 Interest in gaining procurement knowledge, and data fluency, demonstrating insights to make a data\-driven decision.
   

  

 Agile in adopting new tools and ways of working towards continuous improvement to better business outcomes.
   

  

 Leading without authority and collaborating with an inclusive approach across geographical and organizational cultures to achieve mutual success for Micron.
   

  

 Proactive in exploring AI, automation, and emerging technologies to enhance business outcomes
   

  

 Data\-driven mindset with ability to leverage analytics for decision making and process improvements
   

  

**Qualifications \& Skills**
 Minimum 6 years of experience in process management/transformation at a Procurement function of a large cross\-functional organization.

**Role Summary**
 Own and drive the monthly Sales \& Operations Planning (S\&OP) process end\-to\-end across 24×7/Online, Retail (7,000\+ stores), Distribution Centers, and Category (Pharma \& FMCG) teams. Build the organization's demand forecasting and planning capability, including ML\-based forecasting, and lead the evaluation and implementation of the right ERP/planning systems in partnership with Technology.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own and continuously improve the end\-to\-end monthly S\&OP cycle — Portfolio Review, Demand Review, Supply Review, Pre\-S\&OP Reconciliation, and Executive S\&OP — across Retail, 24×7/Online, DC, and Category functions.

title: Senior Manager – Information Technology  (TIS)
description:
**About DESRI**
 DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market\-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 11\.9 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 80 renewable energy projects in 24 states. DESRI is run by a dynamic team with offices located at New York, Denver, and Hyderabad (India).
   

  

**About The Role**
 DESRI is seeking a Senior Manager, Information Technology, to build and lead the firm's internal IT function which is currently run by an MSP. This is a unique opportunity to establish and scale a modern IT organization within a growing infrastructure company. Reporting to senior leadership, Senior Manager, IT will be responsible for developing DESRI's overall IT strategy, managing enterprise systems and infrastructure, overseeing cybersecurity and compliance initiatives, and delivering exceptional end\-user support across the organization.
   

  

 The successful candidate will lead an IT team and will be responsible for building and scaling the IT organization over time. This role requires a hands\-on leader who can balance strategic planning with operational execution while partnering closely with stakeholders across all business functions.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Develop and execute DESRI's enterprise IT roadmap aligned with business objectives and long\-term growth plans.
* Establish the firm's internal IT operating model, governance structure, policies, and processes.
* Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing global IT team across the U.S. and India.
* Manage relationships with external technology vendors, consultants, and service providers.
* Develop and manage the IT budget, including software, infrastructure, and staffing investments.
* Oversee enterprise technology infrastructure, including networking, cloud services (primarily Microsoft Azure), identity management, endpoint management, and collaboration platforms.
* Ensure reliable, secure, and scalable technology services across multiple office locations and remote employees.
* Lead hardware lifecycle management and employee technology onboarding/offboarding processes.
* Drive continuous improvement in end\-user experience and IT service delivery.
* Lead cybersecurity strategy, governance, and operational security programs.
* Establish and maintain security policies, controls, and monitoring capabilities.
* Partner with internal stakeholders and external experts to manage cyber risk, incident response planning, and business continuity programs.
* Ensure compliance with applicable security, regulatory, and audit requirements.
* Partner with Human Capital, Finance, Legal, Development, Asset Management, and other teams to optimize technology solutions and workflows.
* Oversee implementation, administration, integration, and support of enterprise applications, including Microsoft 365, identity platforms (Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD), HRIS systems, and collaboration tools.
* Establish IT service management processes, a Help Desk, and performance metrics.
* Create a culture of responsiveness, accountability, and customer service within the IT organization.
* Ensure timely resolution of technical issues while maintaining high levels of employee satisfaction.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8\-10 years of progressive IT leadership experience, including responsibility for enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, and end\-user support functions.
* Experience leading IT operations in a multi\-site, cross\-border environment, including support for geographically distributed operating assets, remote facilities, and corporate offices across multiple jurisdictions.
* Experience building, scaling, or transforming internal IT organizations.
* Demonstrated success managing distributed or global technology teams.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, identity and access management, endpoint management, networking, and cybersecurity best practices.
* Hands\-on experience deploying and managing enterprise workloads in Microsoft Azure.
* Experience managing enterprise SaaS ecosystems, including Microsoft 365 and related collaboration technologies.
* Proven ability to communicate effectively with executive leadership and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong project management, vendor management, and budgeting experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting rapidly growing organizations.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks such as NIST or ISO 27001\.
* Experience implementing AI\-enabled productivity tools and automation solutions.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, PMP, ITIL, Azure, AWS, or equivalent.

They are responsible for the liaison between PepsiCo and the local police, emergency services and key stakeholders.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* The principal accountabilities of the GCC Hyderabad \& India Foods (South) is driving the implementation and execution of security, crisis management and business continuity management strategies, plans and protocols, and best practices across the GCC Hyderabad facility, as well as supporting the India Security Lead at outlying Foods manufacturing sites. Additional accountabilities include, but are not limited to:
* In line with the broader EMEA security strategy, implement Facility security plan to identify, assess and mitigate reasonably foreseeable security risks to PepsiCo’s People, Assets and Objectives.
* As a strategically important site to the entire PepsiCo business, oversee and facilitate the ongoing strengthening of a sustainable, Crisis Management and Business Continuity Planning and capability program at GCC Hyderabad.

* Maintain strong working relationships with, and provide consultation to, Facility and OU leadership teams.
* Plan and oversee security risk assessments and annual security audits at GCC Hyderabad (and outlying Foods sites) to identify, analyse and evaluate critical vulnerabilities, and to assist in closing these risks through cost\-effective, best practice security controls.
* Analyse security threats and risks inherent in undertaking new business ventures and offer risk\-informed mitigation measures.
* Develop and maintain working relationships with national and local security, emergency response, law enforcement, and regulatory authorities as well as with security directors of other large multinational companies.
* Deliver a Facility\-aligned CAPEX security business plan that ensures effective security spend.
* Develop and deliver security awareness and training programs.
* Advise and assist before, during, and after security incidents, including on\-the\-spot risk assessments and security advice to business travellers.
* Implement operational plan to strengthen the protection of our supply chain at India Foods (South) sites.
* Conduct and coordinate investigations to include counterfeit, extortion, contamination of our products, loss reduction, kidnapping, robberies, Speak Up, fraud, corruption, and security threats against the Region’s interests and associates.
* As necessary and required, support the Corporate Security Executive Protection program by providing pre\-travel logistical assistance and direct operational support to impacted members of executive leadership when they are present within the Sector.
* Work closely with Internal stakeholders, PGRE, S\&T and LT to ensure strong communication and execution of programs.


**Qualifications**
* Understanding of threat actor profiling and assessment.
* Comprehensive knowledge of the ISO 31000 Risk Management standard and risk assessment process.
* Comprehensive knowledge of the ISO 22301 Business Continuity standard.
* Working knowledge of the ISO 28000 Security Risk Management standard.
* Comprehensive knowledge of guard force management, industry regulation and associated labour law.
* Practical working knowledge of video surveillance systems (demonstrable knowledge of Honeywell ProWatch).
* Practical working knowledge of access control systems.
* Practical working knowledge of visitor management systems (with demonstrable knowledge of iLobby).
* Practical working knowledge (and experience) of legally compliant workplace investigations and interviewing.
* Experience in the planning and execution of travel risk management (journey management) and associated Duty of Care obligations.
* Practical working knowledge (and experience) of data privacy compliance and privacy impact assessments.
* A minimum of 7\-10 years of experience, with a mix of public and/or private sector exposure.
* Experience of securing major finance or technical (FinTec) hubs.
* Experience of securing manufacturing sites and associated supply chains.
* Experience in the planning and delivery of executive protection and event security.
* Capital and operational budget formulation and administration.
* Extensive knowledge of national and local security legislation and regulations

description:
Your opportunity
   

  

 At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region
   

  

 As a Senior SSO Engineering People Leader, you will provide strategic direction and senior functional leadership for teams delivering enterprise SSO, modern authentication, federation, and identity security capabilities. This role requires strong technology understanding, broad functional experience, and the ability to lead people leaders or senior engineers through complex, high\-impact identity initiatives. You will shape engineering priorities, influence enterprise identity strategy, strengthen operational resiliency, and ensure authentication services support business growth, security, compliance, and client trust.
   

  

 The Senior SSO Engineering People Leader owns broader execution strategy, operational governance, and functional leadership for SSO engineering capabilities across enterprise platforms, applications, and identity ecosystems. The role is accountable for roadmap alignment, talent development, stakeholder engagement, risk reduction, audit readiness, platform modernization, and measurable delivery outcomes. This leader will partner with senior technology, cybersecurity, risk, compliance, application, infrastructure, and business leaders to advance secure, scalable, and user\-centered identity services
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide overall leadership for the SSO Engineering function, including senior engineers, technical leads, and other IAM engineering resources.
* Define and execute the strategic roadmap for enterprise authentication, federation, and SSO services.
* Provide leadership and governance across technologies including SAML, OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, federation, MFA, passwordless authentication, FIDO2, passkeys, and adaptive authentication.
* Establish architecture and engineering standards for enterprise authentication platforms.
* Lead modernization of legacy authentication patterns toward standards\-based, cloud\-ready, and Zero Trust\-aligned architectures.
* Provide strategic leadership for platforms such as PingFederate, PingAccess, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or equivalent identity technologies.
* Drive platform scalability, resiliency, disaster recovery, high availability, security, observability, and operational maturity.
* Establish standardized patterns for workforce, application, API, cloud, and service authentication.
* Partner with enterprise architecture and cybersecurity teams to define target\-state authentication architecture.
* Drive automation across application onboarding, configuration management, testing, deployments, certificate management, and platform operations.
* Champion CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, policy\-as\-code, automated testing, and DevSecOps practices within IAM engineering.
* Provide governance and technical oversight for high\-risk or complex authentication integrations.
* Lead major platform transformations, migrations, upgrades, consolidations, and modernization initiatives.
* Establish controls to address authentication threats including credential compromise, token misuse, session attacks, unauthorized access, and configuration vulnerabilities.
* Ensure authentication capabilities meet applicable regulatory, cybersecurity, risk, audit, and enterprise control requirements.
* Own engineering performance metrics and executive reporting covering reliability, availability, security, delivery, incidents, onboarding, automation, and technical debt.
* Partner with Product and Application Engineering leaders to prioritize demand and establish scalable application onboarding models.
* Lead capacity planning, workforce strategy, talent development, succession planning, performance management, and engineering skill development.
* Serve as an escalation point for critical authentication incidents and major technology risks.
* Influence senior leaders and stakeholders on identity strategy, technology investments, engineering priorities, and risk decisions.


 What you have
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, 12\+ years of technology experience, with substantial experience in IAM, cybersecurity, authentication, or enterprise security engineering.
* Extensive experience designing or leading enterprise\-scale SSO and federation platforms.
* Deep understanding of SAML 2\.0, OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, JWT, MFA, PKI, certificates, session management, and modern authentication patterns.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise IAM technologies such as Ping Identity, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or comparable platforms.
* Demonstrated experience leading senior engineers and complex engineering organizations.
* Experience establishing technical roadmaps, architecture standards, engineering governance, and operating models.
* Strong understanding of Zero Trust and identity\-centric security architecture.
* Experience with cloud, APIs, containers, CI/CD, automation, and modern software engineering practices.
* Demonstrated success delivering large, complex, cross\-functional technology programs.
* Strong executive communication, influencing, stakeholder management, and decision\-making skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, SC\-300, AZ\-500, enterprise architecture, cloud security, or relevant identity provider certifications are desirable.
* Experience leading IAM engineering within financial services or another highly regulated enterprise.
* Experience modernizing large\-scale legacy authentication environments.
* Knowledge of Privileged Access Management, Identity Governance, Non\-Human Identities, secrets management, API security, and machine\-to\-machine authentication.
* Experience with Kubernetes, containerized platforms, cloud\-native architectures, and public cloud security.
* Knowledge of identity threat detection, authentication telemetry, SIEM/SOC integration, and continuous monitoring.
* Relevant cybersecurity, IAM, architecture, cloud, or leadership certifications.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Ping Identity, Zscaler Private Access, FIDO2/Passkeys, SCIM, REST APIs, Terraform, Python, PowerShell, Git, CI/CD, AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, identity analytics, observability, AI\-driven identity security, and Non\-Human Identity management.
* Experience in financial services, cybersecurity risk management, regulated enterprise technology, or large\-scale identity platform modernization.
* Experience leading Zero Trust, passwordless, identity governance, privileged access, cloud security, non\-human identity, and resilience initiatives across multiple teams or platforms.
* Experience managing vendor relationships, platform strategy, funding/capacity tradeoffs, security control remediation, audit outcomes, and executive\-level reporting.


 What’s in it for you
   

  

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.

* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more

title: Manager, Channel Operations – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN)
description:
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
 At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As the Manager, Channel Operations – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN), you will lead AIN\-based execution of U.S. Channel operations within the Contracts \& Pricing Execution function. This role is responsible for managing Channel Payments, Channel Analytics, contract update processing, CDP maintenance, GCPS administration, scorecard validation, payment package governance, product launch support, operational controls, reconciliations, reporting, documentation, and continuous improvement activities.
   

  

 Reporting to the Senior Manager/Director, Contracts \& Pricing Execution, you will partner closely with ATO Channel SMEs, National Account Managers, Pricing, Market Access, Trade Operations, Finance, Information Systems, Commercial Operations, and AIN cross\-functional teams to ensure accurate, compliant, scalable, and audit\-ready Channel execution. The role will lead AIN Associates and Analysts to support Channel operations while preserving appropriate ATO oversight for strategic decisions, complex contract interpretation, customer\-facing engagement, approvals, and risk management.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
*Channel Operations Leadership*
* Lead end\-to\-end execution of Channel operations including contract update processing, CDP management, GCPS administration, scorecard generation, payment processing, waiver governance, analytics support, reconciliations, and payment package readiness.
* Manage workloads, operational calendars, payment cycles, quarter\-close deliverables, issue inventories, exception management, and execution readiness across Channel processes.
* Ensure repeatable and scalable execution of standard\-state activities transitioning to AIN while maintaining proper escalation pathways for complex decisions and approval requirements.
* Establish operational discipline through KPI management, workload balancing, service expectations, quality reviews, readiness gates, and issue escalation frameworks.


*CDP, Contract \& GCPS Governance*
* Oversee Monthly and Quarterly CDP Update processes, Conga review activities, contract amendment assessments, and operational implementation of approved contract changes.
* Lead GCPS setup, maintenance, strategy updates, tracker governance, and program configuration activities.
* Ensure CDP\-to\-GCPS alignment, execution quality, peer\-review effectiveness, and appropriate documentation retention.
* Partner with NAMs and retained ATO stakeholders on contract interpretation, amendment impact assessments, and complex operational decisions.


*Payments, Validation \& Financial Controls*
* Oversee scorecard generation, DOH validation, net sales reconciliation, payment package readiness, waiver processing, and payment calculation activities.
* Lead review of performance reports, scorecards, payment packages, trend reporting, and reconciliation outputs.
* Ensure SOX\-aligned controls, documentation standards, review evidence, decision logs, and audit readiness requirements are consistently maintained.
* Drive operational governance across payment approvals, exception resolution, reconciliation reviews, and control execution.


*Analytics, Reporting \& Operational Insights*

title: Manager, Membership – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN)
description:
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
 At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As the
 **Manager, Membership – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN)** 
 , you will lead the execution, governance, and continuous improvement of U.S. Membership operations supporting Amgen's commercial contracting and market access organization. You will oversee customer eligibility, GPO alignments, customer onboarding, membership maintenance, contract alignment, customer master data governance, 340B/PHS eligibility management, rebate and pricing\-related customer support, and operational controls.
   

  

 Reporting to the Senior Manager/Director, Contracts \& Pricing Execution, you will partner closely with Membership SMEs, Market Access, Contracting, Pricing, Government Pricing, Customer Operations, Finance, Information Systems, MDM teams, wholesalers, GPOs, and AIN cross\-functional teams to ensure accurate, compliant, scalable, and audit\-ready execution of Membership operations. You will lead a team of Associates and Senior Associates while supporting transition, capability building, stakeholder engagement, and operational excellence across the Membership function.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
*Membership Operations Leadership*
* Lead end\-to\-end Membership operations including customer onboarding, eligibility validation, customer setup, system alignment, ongoing maintenance, reporting, and closeout activities.
* Ensure execution of activities within established SLAs, quality standards, operational controls, and compliance requirements.
* Oversee intake and triage activities for membership requests, declaration forms (DEC), roster updates, customer changes, and contract alignment activities.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for operational issues impacting customer eligibility, membership alignment, customer setup, and stakeholder satisfaction.


*Customer Eligibility \& Membership Governance*
* Lead governance of customer eligibility determinations, GPO participation validation, class\-of\-trade assessments, contract alignment reviews, and membership approvals.
* Oversee validation activities involving DEA, HIN, HIBCC, HRSA, OneKey, customer identifiers, legal entity hierarchies, and parent\-child relationships.
* Review and approve complex customer setup requests, hierarchy modifications, contract eligibility decisions, and compliance\-sensitive customer updates.
* Govern customer additions, drops, strategy changes, acquisitions, organizational restructures, and customer maintenance requests.


*Customer Master Data \& System Governance*
* Oversee customer setup and maintenance activities across HCM, GCPS, SAP, MDM, OneKey, and related commercial operations platforms.
* Ensure timely creation and maintenance of customer records, legal entity hierarchies, customer attributes, contract affiliations, and GPO alignments.
* Partner with MDM and Information Systems teams to resolve customer data issues, interface failures, hierarchy challenges, and system synchronization problems.
* Support UAT activities, system enhancements, process automation initiatives, and technology transformation efforts.


*Rebuttal, Escalations \& Exception Management*
* Lead customer eligibility dispute investigations, denial reviews, rebuttal activities, and exception resolution processes.
* Provide decision support and recommendations for disputed customer eligibility determinations involving GPOs, wholesalers, and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure complete documentation, audit trails, business rationale, and stakeholder communications supporting membership decisions.
* Drive resolution of complex operational issues impacting pricing access, membership alignments, customer eligibility, rebates, chargebacks, and contract execution.


*340B, PHS \& Specialized Membership Programs*
* Oversee quarterly Public Health Service (PHS) and 340B eligibility maintenance activities, including OPA file reviews, customer additions, removals, and eligibility updates.
* Ensure timely maintenance of SAP flags, CPOCOT assignments, customer eligibility statuses, and contract alignments supporting 340B participation.
* Govern controls supporting wholesaler notifications, eligibility reporting, and system synchronization activities.
* Provide oversight for VA, Kaiser, OBU, IBU, Specialty Pharmacy, Hospital Coalition, , and other specialized Membership programs.


*Reporting, Analytics \& Continuous Improvement*
* Own Membership KPI reporting, SLA reporting, operational dashboards, management reporting, customer eligibility reporting, and ad hoc analytical requests.
* Lead trend analysis, root cause investigations, workload assessments, dispute reviews, and operational health monitoring.
* Identify and implement process improvements, automation opportunities, reporting enhancements, and productivity initiatives.
* Support special projects, business initiatives, system implementations, and transformation efforts.


*Compliance, Controls \& Audit Readiness*
* Support special projects, business initiatives, system implementations, and transformation efforts.
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation supporting customer eligibility determinations, approvals, setup activities, roster updates, and membership decisions.
* Support SOX testing, internal audits, compliance reviews, and control monitoring activities.
* Proactively identify and mitigate operational, financial, compliance, and data quality risks.


*People Leadership, Transition \& Capability Building*
* Lead, coach, and develop Membership Associates and Senior Associates within AIN.
* Establish performance expectations, quality standards, career development plans, and capability development frameworks.
* Support hiring, onboarding, knowledge transfer, and workforce planning activities.
* Partner with ATO SMEs to establish SOPs, training plans, readiness criteria, governance models, and transition plans supporting migration of Membership activities into AIN.
* Drive a culture of operational excellence, accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus.


**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is an experienced pharmaceutical commercial operations leader with expertise in customer eligibility, membership operations, contract administration, master data governance, market access operations, and stakeholder management. The individual should possess strong leadership, analytical, problem\-solving, and change\-management skills, with the ability to lead teams in a highly regulated environment.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in business administration, Finance, Commerce, Economics, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Healthcare Administration, or related field.
* 8 to 12 years of experience in pharmaceutical commercial operations, Membership operations, Market Access, Customer Master Data, Managed Markets, Contracts \& Pricing, Revenue Management, or related business functions.
* 2\+ years of people leadership, project leadership, or process ownership experience.
* Strong analytical, operational, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working in regulated environments with controls, governance, and compliance requirements.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Deep understanding of U.S. pharmaceutical customer eligibility, GPO operations, customer master data management, Market Access, and Membership governance.
* Experience with GCPS, HCM, SAP, Model N, OneKey, HIBCC, HRSA/OPA, Tableau, Power BI, and related commercial operations systems.
* Knowledge of 340B, PHS, Hospital Coalition, Specialty Pharmacy, VA, Kaiser, OBU, IBU, customer onboarding, and eligibility processes.
* Experience with Model N GCPS, SAP, Conga, IntegriChain, Tableau, Qlik, Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, SharePoint, and automation technologies.
* Experience supporting audits, SOX controls, governance programs, and operational transformation initiatives.
* Experience leading global delivery teams, transition programs, and capability\-building initiatives.
* Strong leadership, executive communication, stakeholder management, and change management skills.

title: USA Properties Business Manager
description:
**PRIME DEVELOPERS US** 




*Job Description* 




**Property Business Manager** 




*(Based at Hyderabad Office, India \| Managing One US Commercial Property)* 




**Company** 





 Prime Developers – Texas\-based commercial real estate developer/owner\-operator (est. 2017\), managing retail, flex, and office plaza properties across Austin, Cedar Park, Leander, and Lewisville, TX.
 




**Location** 





 Hyderabad Office, India – in\-office role
 




**Scope** 





 One assigned US commercial property
 




**Reports To** 





 Company Leadership / Ownership
 




**Direct Reports** 





 On\-site Property Manager and ground staff at the assigned property
 




**Work Hours** 





 Overlap with US business hours (Central Time) required
 




**Reporting Cadence** 





 Regular reports to leadership on occupancy, maintenance, and financial performance
 




**About Prime Developers** 





 Prime Developers has offered real estate development and investment services since 2017, specializing in iconic commercial and residential properties across the Texas market. The company owns and operates a growing portfolio of multi\-tenant retail, flex, and office plazas, and is actively acquiring additional commercial spaces — creating an expanding need for hands\-on, accountable operational oversight across the portfolio.
 




**Role Overview** 





 Prime Developers is looking for a Property Business Manager, based at the company's Hyderabad office, to take full ownership of the day\-to\-day wellbeing, performance, and growth of one assigned US commercial property. This is not a ground\-up development role — the focus is on operating, maintaining, and growing an established building/commercial space after acquisition or completion.
 





 The person in this role will act as the single point of accountability for the assigned property, directing and coordinating an on\-site Property Manager and ground staff based in the US, while personally owning leasing/bookings, maintenance oversight, marketing, accounting coordination, and overall growth of the asset. Regular reports will be shared with leadership on occupancy, maintenance, and financial performance.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Own the end\-to\-end performance of the assigned commercial property — treat it like a business unit with full accountability for its upkeep and growth.
 



 • Exercise decision\-making authority on growth\-oriented initiatives for the property — leasing terms, budget allocation, capex, vendor contracts — and be able to justify each decision with clear financial and operational reasoning.
 **(This will discuss with client)** 




 • Direct and coordinate the on\-site Property Manager and ground staff (maintenance, leasing/front\-desk, vendors) from the Hyderabad office.
 



 • Oversee bookings, leasing, and occupancy — track vacancies, tenant renewals, and new leasing opportunities to maximize occupancy and revenue.
 



 • Manage maintenance operations — schedule repairs and preventive maintenance, track work orders, and ensure ground staff/vendors resolve issues promptly.
 



 • Coordinate accounting and financial oversight — track rent collection, operating expenses, budgets, and P\&L for each property in partnership with accounting/finance resources.
 **(If Applicable)** 




 • Drive marketing and growth initiatives — improve property visibility, tenant mix, and occupancy through marketing efforts and local partnerships.
 



 • Manage vendor and contractor relationships — sourcing, negotiating, and overseeing US\-based vendors for repairs, landscaping, security, and other services.
 **(Client Decision)** 




 • Ensure compliance with US property regulations, local codes, licensing, and insurance requirements applicable to each property.
 **(If applicable/required)** 




 • Provide regular reporting to leadership on occupancy, financial performance, maintenance status, and growth initiatives for the property.
 



 • Be ready to take on additional properties and support onboarding/operational setup as the company's portfolio grows.
 



**Requirements** 




 • MBA in Finance (or equivalent) with 2–3 years of relevant experience, including a demonstrated track record of making business/financial decisions and justifying them with sound reasoning and data.
 



 • Prior experience in property management, facilities management, or commercial real estate operations (US market experience strongly preferred but not mandate).
 



 • Demonstrated ability to manage a team remotely and hold on\-site staff accountable without being physically present at the property.
 



 • Working knowledge of leasing/occupancy management, basic accounting/P\&L, and vendor management.
 



 • Strong written and verbal English communication skills; comfortable working significant overlap with US business hours.
 



 • Familiarity with property management or leasing software (e.g., AppFolio, Buildium, or similar) is a plus.
 **(These are software’s recommended but its client decision)** 



* • Highly organized, ownership\-driven mindset — comfortable being the accountable owner of an asset's outcomes rather than just a coordinator.

Eyeline is a global team of risk takers, innovators and perfectionists who achieve creative visions and have fun doing it. A dynamic workforce nestled within the industry’s most intriguing cities, united by a drive to push the boundaries of storytelling. Learn more.
   

  

 The Animation Supervisor oversees the day\-to\-day operations of the animation department. They are responsible for expediting high\-quality character, creature, and object animation for photo\-realistic feature films.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partners with studio leadership to deliver the highest quality animation
* Works with animators and cross\-department supervisors to identify and solve problems, both technically and artistically
* Spends time as needed in hands on shot delivery
* Liaises with other production team members to ensure production deadlines are met
* Actively involved in artist hiring as well as coaching, training and development


**Qualifications**
* Significant visual effects production and leadership experience on high\-end live\-action feature films and episodic TV
* Proven technical and leadership capabilities
* Experience in leading, mentoring, and training large teams
* Exceptional organizational skills; understands how to prioritize tasks, assignments with team skills
* Expert knowledge of Nuke and Maya is required
* 3ds Max, Photoshop, and Zbrush experience is a plus
* Must have a strong sense of animation: acting, staging, posing, weight, timing, storytelling, and staying on model

* Strong understanding of the principles of animation, exceptional artistic skills

title: Vice President - Platform Engineering & Operations
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
 At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
   

  

 Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
   

  

 We are seeking a visionary and execution\-oriented
 **VP of Platform Engineering \& Operations** 
 to lead our India\-based technology hub. This is a high\-impact leadership role responsible for bridging the gap between cutting\-edge platform engineering and world\-class operational excellence.
   

  

 You will lead a multi\-disciplinary team focused on building resilient, self\-healing platforms while overseeing global Tier 1 and Tier 2 operational support. The ideal candidate isn't just an "operator" but a builder who views every manual task as an automation opportunity and every cost as a FinOps challenge to be optimized.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Strategic Leadership \& People Management
* Site Leadership: Act as the primary lead for the India Platform \& Ops organization, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Talent Development: Hire, mentor, and retain top\-tier engineering talent, building a high\-performing team capable of supporting global scale.
* Performance Management: Drive organizational success through a rigorous OKR (Objectives and Key Results) framework and clear KPIs (MTTR, MTTD, Change Success Rate, etc.).
* Operations \& Reliability
* Global Support: Oversee Tier 1 and Tier 2 operational support functions, ensuring 24/7 availability and adherence to strict SLAs.
* Incident Management: Lead the strategy for major incident response and post\-mortem analysis to prevent recurrence.
* Controls \& Monitoring: Implement robust controls and observability stacks to monitor system health, security compliance, and data integrity.
* Automation \& AI Mindset
* Self\-Healing Infrastructure: Shift the organization from reactive "firefighting" to a proactive, AIOps\-driven model.
* CI/CD \& DevOps: Champion the adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated deployment pipelines to eliminate manual handoffs.
* Tooling Innovation: Leverage AI/ML to predict potential system failures and optimize resource allocation.
* FinOps \& Cloud Economics
* Cost Optimization: Drive the FinOps agenda, ensuring cloud consumption is transparent, attributed, and optimized.
* Budget Management: Manage the India center’s operational budget, balancing innovation costs with bottom\-line efficiency.


**Required Qualifications**
* Experience: 15\+ years in Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, or SRE, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role (Director/VP) within a Global Capability Center (GCC) or large\-scale tech firm.
* Technical Breadth: Deep understanding of cloud\-native architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP),, and modern observability tools
* Operational Excellence: Proven track record of managing Tier 1/2 support teams and improving reliability metrics.
* Financial Acumen: Experience implementing FinOps practices and managing multi\-million dollar budgets.
* Education: B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. MBA is a plus.


 Core Competencies
   

  

* The "Automation First" Filter: A natural tendency to automate repetitive tasks and a disdain for "toil."
* Data\-Driven Decision Making: Ability to translate complex technical telemetry into actionable business insights.
* Executive Presence: Comfortable presenting to C\-suite stakeholders and influencing global strategy from the India site.
* Resilience: The ability to remain calm and lead effectively during high\-pressure system outages or rapid organizational shifts.


 Why Join Us?
   

  

 You will have the autonomy to shape the future of our global platform. We don't just want someone to keep the lights on; we want a leader who will reinvent the way we think about infrastructure, making it invisible, intelligent, and incredibly efficient.

 Location: Hyderabad, Telangana
 



 Employment: Full\-time

 We are planning to establish a PET and plastic recycling plant in Hyderabad and are seeking an
 



 experienced Project Head to take complete ownership of the project from concept to
 



 commercial operations.
 



 The selected person will lead feasibility studies, site selection, government approvals, plant
 



 design, machinery selection, construction, installation, commissioning, recruitment, feedstock
 



 sourcing, customer development and ongoing plant operations.
 



 Key responsibilities:
 



  Prepare the detailed project report, business plan, budget and implementation schedule.
 



  Recommend plant capacity, recycling process, product mix and technology.

  Control project cost, timelines, construction quality, contracts and site safety.
 



  Supervise machinery installation, trials, commissioning and performance testing.
 



  Develop reliable sources for PET bottles and other approved plastic feedstock.
 



  Establish customers for recycled flakes, pellets and other finished products.
 



  Recruit and train the production, maintenance, quality, EHS and administrative teams.
 



  Establish SOPs, quality systems, preventive maintenance and production reporting.

 Environmental Engineering.

 recycling plant.
 



  Knowledge of sorting, shredding, washing, separation, drying, extrusion, filtration,
 



 pelletizing, utilities and wastewater treatment.
 



  Experience handling capex, vendor negotiations, statutory coordination and project
 



 teams.
 



  Willingness to work regularly from the project site in Hyderabad.
 



 Candidates should submit their resume with details of the recycling plants they have
 



 established, including capacity, products, project budget, timeline, machinery suppliers, exact
 



 responsibilities and operational results.

title: Manager R&D
description:
**Work Schedule**
 Standard (Mon\-Fri)
   

  

**Environmental Conditions**
 Laboratory Setting, Office, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)
   

  

**About Company:**
 Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. (NYSE: TMO) is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $45 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. While our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving sophisticated analytical challenges, growing efficiency in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life\-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our global distributed team delivers an outstanding combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry\-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.
   

  

 DESCRIPTION:
   

  

 As Manager, R\&D, you will lead a focused and diverse SPCI Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VAVE) team, driving cost optimization, project execution, continuous improvement. You will collaborate with global and cross\-functional partners to build a strong pipeline of VAVE initiatives and deliver measurable business impact.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the SPCI VAVE team and drive the strategy, development, and execution of cost\-out initiatives across programs.
* Deliver \~$5M or more in annual cost savings while developing and maintaining a strong \~$10M\+ cost\-out pipeline to support the following year’s savings commitments.
* Drive execution excellence by coordinating cross\-functional project teams, ensuring projects are delivered on schedule while maintaining or improving product quality.
* Generate and develop cost\-out opportunities using structured ideation and analysis techniques, including product cost analysis, should\-costing, costed BOM analysis, site material\-spend analysis, product teardown, competitive benchmarking, and VAVE methodologies.
* Engage effectively with global partners and stakeholders, communicate progress, highlight risks and opportunities, and proactively seek support when required.
* Provide leadership, supervision, and coordination across project management and engineering design activities for VAVE projects as part of the programs.
* Partners with project leaders to identify and address project risks early, establish clear mitigation plans, and remove barriers to successful execution.
* Collaborate closely to develop robust Design Verification Plans (DVPs) supporting project implementation.
* Identify process gaps and establish standard work and PPI systems to strengthen execution and drive continuous improvement. Apply PPI and Lean methodologies and support PPI, Keys, and Lean initiatives.
* Develop and execute the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), including effective management of resources and project expenses.
* Establish and maintain the team's proficiency matrix and resource\-loading plans to ensure the right capabilities and capacity are available to meet program priorities.
* Mentor, coach, and develop team members, providing guidance and opportunities that support their continued professional and technical growth.
* Perform all responsibilities in alignment with the Code of Ethics, Diversity \& Inclusion principles, and the 4\-I Values.


**Required Qualifications, Skills And Competencies**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* 10\+ years of engineering experience (8\+ years with a Master’s degree), with strong experience in sustenance engineering and Cost\-Out/VAVE project execution.
* 3\+ years of leadership and multi\-project management experience, including management of programs with \~25\+ concurrent projects.
* Proven track record of delivering approximately $5M\+ in cost savings and building and managing a significant Cost\-Out/VAVE pipeline.
* Strong expertise in VAVE and product cost optimization, with hands\-on experience in product cost analysis, should\-costing, costed BOM analysis, material\-spend analysis, product teardown, and competitive benchmarking.
* Proficiency in stage\-gate and technical review processes, with experience driving projects through key engineering and business milestones.
* Strong program management skills, including planning, prioritization, execution, risk management, resource allocation, and delivery against commitments.
* Demonstrated ability to drive execution excellence across multiple cross\-functional initiatives, delivering projects on schedule while maintaining or improving product quality.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across technical, business, and leadership audiences.
* Strong people leadership and talent development skills, including mentoring, coaching, capability development, resource planning, and performance management.
* Strong analytical, critical\-thinking, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to support identification of root causes and drive effective solutions.


**Preferred Qualifications, Skills And Competencies**
* Master’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; MBA is an added advantage.
* Proven ability to lead strategic, cross\-functional initiatives and translate strategy into actionable plans and measurable results.
* Strong knowledge and practical application of PPI, Lean, and Continuous Improvement methodologies.
* Working knowledge of regulatory requirements, product certifications, and applicable engineering standards, preferably in a regulated product development environment.
* Ability to operate effectively in a global matrix organization, build strong cross\-functional relationships, and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Ability to interpret complex simulation, experimental, and engineering data and translate insights into sound technical and business decisions.

 Business Information caters to research and information needs of various groups in the Bank. **Job Description\***
 Individual will be executing \& delivering high quality of business research including complex industry requests. **Responsibilities\***

* Willingness to work in a 24\*7 (Rotational Shift) set\-up as well as on Indian holidays
* Provide next level training to upcoming researchers and guide junior researcher on complex research queries
* Ensure high quality and deadline is met on all research requests
* Ability to understand the financial and market terminologies and provide the relevant information in short notice
* Liaise with bankers to understand their requirement and to resolve quality issues
* Perform root cause analysis on negative feedbacks from Bankers
* Proficiency in Workflow Management


**Requirements\***
**Education** 
 \- Post Graduate (MBA's / Masters) degree in Finance or Business Administration
   

  

 Certifications if any \- Any certification related to research is preferred, but not mandatory
   

  

**Experience Range** 
 \- Overall experience of 5 to 7 years in Business Research/Information Research kind of teams with at least 3 years of Industry level research experience is required (Prior work flow management experience is desired)
   

  

**Foundational Skills** 
 \*
   

  

* Hands\-on experience of Industry/Market level databases such as Gartner, Wood Mackenzie, IDC, BMI, EMIS, Frost \& Sullivan, Euromonitor, SNL, Nielsen, etc.
* Advanced working knowledge on sources such as Factiva, Bloomberg, FactSet, Thomson Eikon, Capital IQ, EIU, Autex, SDC, Merger Market, VentureSource, etc. for performing News runs, Advanced Screenings, Extracting data to excel using formulae builders/excel plug\-ins, Extracting complex documents (Indentures, Credit Agreements), Country/Economy research, Trading data on Securities, Proficiency in M\&A, ECM, DCM, PIBs, etc
* Should have experience in managing workflow including assigning requests based on the knowledge level of the associate, negotiating deadlines with bankers, etc.

* Ability to work under pressure with high attention to detail and ability to maintain confidentiality


**Desired Skills\***
* Personal motivated and ability to function as a team player
* Proactive and flexible
* Strong work ethics

title: Lead, Client Service Operations
